gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ; ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
englishTranslation: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace ~

gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ. ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਕਾਰ; ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
englishTranslation: By His Command, bodies are created; His Command cannot be described.

gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਤਾਣੁ; ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Some sing of His Power-who has that Power?

gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ. ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਇ; ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: True is the Master, True is His Name-speak it with infinite love.

gurmukhi: ਥਾਪਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ; ਕੀਤਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: He cannot be established, He cannot be created.

gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਾ, ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ; ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ. ਕਿ ਨਾਇ ਕਰੀ ॥
englishTranslation: If I am pleasing to Him, then that is my pilgrimage and cleansing bath. Without pleasing Him, what good are ritual cleansings?

gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਆਰਜਾ; ਹੋਰ ਦਸੂਣੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Even if you could live throughout the four ages, or even ten times more,
Listening-the Siddhas, the spiritual teachers, the heroic warriors, the yogic masters.
Listening-dive deep into the ocean of virtue.

gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੇ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ; ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: The state of the faithful cannot be described.
The faithful have intuitive awareness and intelligence.
The path of the faithful shall never be blocked.
The faithful find the Door of Liberation.
The chosen ones, the self-elect, are accepted and approved.
When the hands and the feet and the body are dirty,
Pilgrimages, austere discipline, compassion and charity
There are nether worlds beneath nether worlds, and hundreds of thousands of heavenly worlds above.

gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ; ਏਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
englishTranslation: The praisers praise the Lord, but they do not obtain intuitive understanding

gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ. ਸਿਫਤੀ; ਕਹਣਿ. ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Endless are His Praises, endless are those who speak them.
His Blessings are so abundant that there can be no written account of them.
Priceless are His Virtues, Priceless are His Dealings.

gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ, ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ; ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
englishTranslation: Where is that Gate, and where is that Dwelling, in which You sit and take care of all?

gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਦਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ, ਸਰਮੁ ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ; ਧਿਆਨ ਕੀ. ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Make contentment your ear-rings, humility your begging bowl, and meditation the ashes you apply to your body.

gurmukhi: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ, ਦਇਆ ਭੰਡਾਰਣਿ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਾਦ ॥
englishTranslation: Let spiritual wisdom be your food, and compassion your attendant. The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates in each and every heart.

gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਮਾਈ. ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਿਆਈ; ਤਿਨਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
englishTranslation: The One Divine Mother conceived and gave birth to the three deities.
On world after world are His Seats of Authority and His Storehouses.

gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਜੀਭੌ. ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ; ਲਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਲਖ ਵੀਸ ॥
englishTranslation: If I had 100,000 tongues, and these were then multiplied twenty times more, with each tongue,
No power to speak, no power to keep silent.
This is righteous living in the realm of Dharma.
In the realm of wisdom, spiritual wisdom reigns supreme.
In the realm of karma, the Word is Power.
Let self-control be the furnace, and patience the goldsmith.

gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਬੇਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥ ਪਹਰਿਆ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
englishTranslation: Sree Raag, The Word Of Devotee Baynee Jee: To Be Sung To The Tune Of "Pehray":

gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ; ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
englishTranslation: In the month of Chayt, by meditating on the Lord of the Universe, a deep and profound joy arises.

gurmukhi: ਵੈਸਾਖਿ ਧੀਰਨਿ ਕਿਉ ਵਾਢੀਆ; ਜਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ॥
englishTranslation: In the month of Vaisaakh, how can the bride be patient? She is separated from her Beloved.

gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਠਿ ਜੁੜੰਦਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ; ਜਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵੰਨਿ ॥
englishTranslation: In the month of Jayt'h, the bride longs to meet with the Lord. All bow in humility before Him.

gurmukhi: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਤਪੰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ. ਨ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
englishTranslation: The month of Aasaarh seems burning hot, to those who are not close to their Husband Lord.

gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ; ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: In the month of Saawan, the soul-bride is happy, if she falls in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

gurmukhi: ਭਾਦੁਇ. ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀਆ; ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
englishTranslation: In the month of Bhaadon, she is deluded by doubt, because of her attachment to duality.

gurmukhi: ਅਸੁਨਿ. ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਉਮਾਹੜਾ; ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: In the month of Assu, my love for the Lord overwhelms me. How can I go and meet the Lord?

gurmukhi: ਕਤਿਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ; ਦੋਸੁ. ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
englishTranslation: In the month of Katak, do good deeds. Do not try to blame anyone else.

gurmukhi: ਮੰਘਿਰਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਸੋਹੰਦੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਠੜੀਆਹ ॥
englishTranslation: In the month of Maghar, those who sit with their Beloved Husband Lord are beautiful.

gurmukhi: ਪੋਖਿ. ਤੁਖਾਰੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ; ਕੰਠਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ॥
englishTranslation: In the month of Poh, the cold does not touch those, whom the Husband Lord hugs close in His Embrace.

gurmukhi: ਮਾਘਿ. ਮਜਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂਆ; ਧੂੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: In the month of Maagh, let your cleansing bath be the dust of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

gurmukhi: ਫਲਗੁਣਿ. ਅਨੰਦ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ; ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ. ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਆਇ ॥
englishTranslation: In the month of Phalgun, bliss comes to those, unto whom the Lord, the Friend, has been revealed.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਰੇ ॥
englishTranslation: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord-their affairs are all resolved.
Maajh, Fifth Mehl: Day And Night:

gurmukhi: ਵਾਰ ਮਾਝ ਕੀ. ਤਥਾ ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਮਲਕ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਤਥਾ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਹੜਾ ਸੋਹੀਆ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਗਾਵਣੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Vaar In Maajh, And Saloks Of The First Mehl: To Be Sung To The Tune Of "Malik Mureed And Chandrahraa Sohee-Aa"

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay & Dho-Padhay:
Raag Gauree Gwaarayree: Third Mehl, Chau-Padhay:
Fifth Mehl, Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Chau-Padhay:

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, Dho-Padhay:
Raag Gauree Chaytee, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਰਹੋਏ ਕੇ ਛੰਤ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
englishTranslation: Gauree Bairaagan, Chhants Of Rehoay, Fifth Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Gauree, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl: Gauree Gwaarayree:
Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl, Karhalay:
Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
englishTranslation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:
Raag Gauree Poorbee, Chhant, Third Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Sukhmani: Peace of Mind, the Nectar of the Name of God.

gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
englishTranslation: In the remembrance of God are wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures.

gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ; ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
englishTranslation: The remembrance of God is the highest and most exalted of all.
Those who remember God are wealthy.
Those who remember God generously help others.
Remembering God, one's works are accomplished.
Remembering the Lord, His devotees are famous and radiant.
The rulers of the all the world are unhappy;
You shall not be saved by hundreds of thousands and millions of helping hands.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਮਾਰਗ ਕੇ; ਗਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨ. ਕੋਸਾ ॥
englishTranslation: On that path where the miles cannot be counted,
Unto the devotee, the Naam is an article of daily use.

gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
englishTranslation: The Name of the Lord is the path of liberation for His humble servants.

gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ; ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜੀਨਾ ॥
englishTranslation: The Lord's Name, Har, Har, is the treasure of wealth of His servants.
This Elysian Tree of miraculous powers is the Name of the Lord.

gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਫਿਰੈ; ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
englishTranslation: You may roam over the nine continents of the world and live a very long life;
With your mind filled with desire, you may give up your body at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage;

gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
englishTranslation: Even with great cleverness, the fear of death clings to you.
One who prays for the four cardinal blessings
Among all persons, the supreme person is the one
To the poor, Your Name is wealth.
Of all religions, the best religion

gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬਸਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: By His Grace, you abide in comfort upon the earth.
From beginning to end, He is our Protector,
Forsaking the jewel, they are engrossed with a shell.
They belong to the human species, but they act like animals.
By listening, how can the blind find the path?

gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ; ਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਨ. ਚੀਤਿ ॥
englishTranslation: The Lord, our Help and Support, is always with us, but the mortal does not remember Him.
You are our Lord and Master; to You, I offer this prayer.
God the Banker gives endless capital to the mortal,
The many forms of attachment to Maya shall surely pass away
False are body, wealth, and all relations.
False are the ears which listen to the slander of others.
The life of the faithless cynic is totally useless.
He says one thing, and does something else.
Offer your prayers to the Supreme Lord God, who knows everything.
By His Grace, you wear silks and satins;
By His Grace, you have a healthy, golden body;
By His Grace, you wear decorations;

gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
englishTranslation: By His Grace, you give donations in abundance to charities;
By His Grace, you listen to the sound current of the Naad.
By His Grace, you are famous all over the world;
Those, whom He inspires to chant, chant His Name.
In the Company of the Holy, one meets the Incomprehensible Lord.
In the Company of the Holy, all one's enemies become friends.

gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
englishTranslation: In the Company of the Holy, the mind never wanders.

gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
englishTranslation: In the Company of the Holy, all one's family is saved.

gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
englishTranslation: In the Company of the Holy, there is no suffering.

gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸੁਨਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: In the Company of the Holy, listen to the Name of the Lord.

gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਬੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: The glory of the Holy people is not known to the Vedas.
The God-conscious being is the purest of the pure;
The God-conscious being is the dust of all.
The God-conscious being centers his hopes on the One alone.
The God-conscious being loves the One Lord alone.
The God-conscious being cannot be appraised.

gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
englishTranslation: The God-conscious being is the Creator of all the world.
The true Vaishnaav, the devotee of Vishnu, is the one with whom God is thoroughly pleased.
The true Bhagaautee, the devotee of Adi Shakti, loves the devotional worship of God.
He is a true Pandit, a religious scholar, who instructs his own mind.
The Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra, is spiritual wisdom for everyone.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
englishTranslation: One whose mind is a home for the Supreme Lord God
One who, in his soul, loves the Will of God,
All places belong to the Supreme Lord God.
Many millions are Siddhas, celibates and Yogis.
Many millions abide in heated activity, slothful darkness and peaceful light.
Many millions inhabit the nether regions.
Many millions become Bairaagees, who renounce the world.
Many millions are the fields of creation and the galaxies.
Many millions are the servants of the Supreme Lord God.
If it pleases God, one attains salvation.

gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਤੇ; ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ॥
englishTranslation: Tell me - what can a mere mortal do?

gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ; ਨੀਚ ਕੀਟ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ॥
englishTranslation: In an instant, the lowly worm is transformed into a king.

gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ; ਨਾਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਹਾਥ ॥
englishTranslation: There is no power in the hands of mortal beings;
Sometimes, they dance in various ways.
Sometimes, as scholars, they deliver lectures.
Sometimes, this being attains the Company of the Holy.
One who becomes wealthy and takes pride in it
If someone does millions of good deeds, while acting in ego,

gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ; ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: As long as someone thinks that he is the one who acts,

gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਖਟੇ; ਲਖ ਕਉ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
englishTranslation: Earning a thousand, he runs after a hundred thousand.
The Doer, the Cause of causes, is the Creator Lord.
He Himself instructs, and He Himself learns.
True, True, True is God, our Lord and Master.

gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੂਖਨ ਤੇ; ਮੁਖੁ ਭਵੈ ॥
englishTranslation: Slandering the Saints, one becomes a wry-faced malcontent.
The slanderer of the Saint is the worst evil-doer.
The slanderer of the Saint is forever impure.

gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਅਧ ਬੀਚ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
englishTranslation: The slanderer of the Saint breaks down mid-way.
The slanderer of the Saint bewails like this

gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਬਿਗੜ ਰੂਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: The slanderer of the Saint becomes deformed.

gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ; ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: All hearts are His; He is the Creator.
Praise the Formless Lord in your mind.
Very fortunate are those humble beings in this world,
By Guru's Grace, one understands himself;

gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
englishTranslation: One who focuses his conscious mind on the Lord God

gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਨਮੈ; ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਰੈ ॥
englishTranslation: Nothing is born, and nothing dies.
Those who know God are glorious.

gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ; ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Whatever you do, do it for the Love of God.
One who is good-looking should not be vain;
As a palace is supported by its pillars,
O foolish mind, why do you cry and bewail?

gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ; ਲੈਨਿ ਤੂ ਆਇਆ ॥
englishTranslation: This merchandise, which you have come to obtain

gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ; ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Wash the feet of the Holy, and drink in this water.
He infuses life back into the dead.

gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
englishTranslation: One who has faith in the Guru in his mind
He is the Fulfiller of wishes, who can give us Sanctuary;

gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਕੀ; ਮਿਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: There is no limit to His play.

gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ; ਨਾਨਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
englishTranslation: Many are His forms; many are His colors.
The Naam is the Support of all creatures.

gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਸਤਿ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਤਿ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: His form is true, and true is His place.
True are the Teachings, and the Instructions of the Holy.
Gazing upon His wondrous wonder, I am wonder-struck and amazed!
One who believes in the Embodiment of Truth with all his heart
The servant is obedient to his Lord and Master.
He covers the faults of His servant.
He infuses His Power into the tiny ant;
Time after time, again and again, meditate on God.
Chant His Praises with your tongue, day and night.

gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: O my mind, seek their protection;

gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ॥
englishTranslation: That selfless servant, who lives in the Guru's household,

gurmukhi: ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸਵੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
englishTranslation: One who obeys the Guru's Teachings one hundred per cent
Blessed is His Darshan; receiving it, one is purified.
The tongue is one, but His Praises are many.

gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ; ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Only a few obtain this ambrosial essence of the Lord's Name.
In the burning heat, a soothing coolness prevails.
He Himself is absolute and unrelated; He Himself is also involved and related.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ; ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: The wealth which you chase after in the four directions
Enlighten your mind with the Name of the Lord.
One who contemplates the essence of reality, is said to be the true person.
Your wealth shall not go with you;

gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ; ਤੂੰ ਲੇਹਿ ਇਆਨੇ ॥
englishTranslation: Take the Guru's advice, you ignorant fool;
Chanting His Glories, your filth shall be washed off.
Meditate on the One, and worship the One.

gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: By God's Gracious Glance, there is great peace.
The wishes of the Lord's servant are fulfilled.

gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿ. ਘਾਲ ਨ ਭਾਨੈ ॥
englishTranslation: Why forget Him, who does not overlook our efforts?
O friends, O Saints, make this your work.
Love and affection, and the taste of yearning, have welled up within;
God, the Forgiving Lord, is kind to the poor.
Everything is obtained: the heavens, liberation and deliverance,
When there was only God the Master,
When the Immortal Lord was seated at ease,

gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਪੁਰਖ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
englishTranslation: When there was only the Immaculate Being, the Lord of beings,

gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
englishTranslation: When His Glory was contained within Himself,
When the Undeceiveable, Impenetrable, Inscrutable One was self-absorbed,
When He Himself fashioned the visible world of the creation,
Wherever the Eternal Lord's devotee is, He Himself is there.

gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
englishTranslation: All beings and creatures are in His Hands.
The Perfect, Merciful Lord is pervading everywhere.
The Lord's humble servant is committed to His Name.
Join the Company of the Holy, and be happy.
Embellish both this world and the next;

gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ; ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Where can anyone go, to get away from Him?

gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ॥
englishTranslation: His wisdom is perfect, and His Glance is Ambrosial.
The Infinite Lord is inside, and outside as well.
See Him in the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees.

gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ; ਪੇਖਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
englishTranslation: In the eye of the Saint, everything is God.
He Himself is True, and all that He has made is True.
In all forms, He Himself is pervading.

gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ; ਸੁ. ਨਾਹੀ ਬੁਰਾ ॥
englishTranslation: If it comes from Him, it cannot be bad.

gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਾਨੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: One who knows Him, obtains everlasting peace.
Happiness, intuitive peace, poise and bliss
The most sublime hymns are the Words of the Holy.
Hearing that He can give Sanctuary, I have come seeking His Sanctuary.

gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ; ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤ ॥
englishTranslation: Sing the Praises of God, O Saints, O friends,
Comfort, peace and tranquility, wealth and the nine treasures;
One who chants this treasure in his mind

gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ; ਸੁਨੈ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
englishTranslation: One, within whose mind it abides, and who listens to it with love
T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days: Gauree, Fifth Mehl,

englishTranslation: Whose son is he? Whose father is he?

gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋ ਕਉ; ਭਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
englishTranslation: Now, the Lord, my King, has become my help and support.

gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ. ਥਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ; ਸੂਤਕ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
englishTranslation: There is pollution in the water, and pollution on the land; whatever is born is polluted.

gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ. ਤੂੰ ਐਸਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ; ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ, ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: O my Sovereign Lord King, You are Fearless; You are the Carrier to carry us across, O my Lord King. ||1||Pause||

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee, First House:

gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਜਰੀਐ. ਤਬ ਹੋਇ ਭਸਮ ਤਨੁ; ਰਹੈ. ਕਿਰਮ ਦਲ ਖਾਈ ॥
englishTranslation: When the body is burnt, it turns to ashes; if it is not cremated, then it is eaten by armies of worms.

gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਭੈ ਮਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ; ਕਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
englishTranslation: Listening to all the teachings of the Vedas and the Puraanas, I wanted to perform the religious rituals.

gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਗਮ ਦੂਧ ਕੇ ਠਾਟਾ ॥
englishTranslation: Let the sacred scriptures be your milk and cream,
Without Him, we cannot even live;
What use is it to read, and what use is it to study?
In his heart there is deception, and yet in his mouth are words of wisdom.
O Saints, my windy mind has now become peaceful and still.

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee, Second House:

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Ravi Daas Jee:

gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਂਧੇ. ਮੋਹ ਫਾਸ; ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਧਨਿ. ਤੁਮ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
englishTranslation: If I am bound by the noose of emotional attachment, then I shall bind You, Lord, with the bonds of love.

gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ. ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਓ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਅਬਿਬੇਕੈ ॥
englishTranslation: I obtained this precious human life as a reward for my past actions, but without discriminating wisdom, it is wasted in vain.

gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੁਰਤਰ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ; ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
englishTranslation: He is the ocean of peace; the miraculous tree of life, the wish-fulfilling jewel, and the Kaamadhayna, the cow which fulfills all desires, all are in His power.

gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਗਿਰਿਵਰ; ਤਉ ਹਮ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
englishTranslation: If You are the mountain, Lord, then I am the peacock.

gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ. ਪਵਨ ਕਾ ਥੰਭਾ; ਰਕਤ ਬੁੰਦ ਕਾ ਗਾਰਾ ॥
englishTranslation: The body is a wall of water, supported by the pillars of air; the egg and sperm are the mortar.
I am a shoemaker, but I do not know how to mend shoes.

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਭੀਖਨ ਕੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Bheekhan Jee:

gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ; ਪੁੰਨਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
englishTranslation: Such is the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the invaluable jewel, the most sublime wealth, which I have found through good deeds.

gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਪਹਰ. ਪਹਰ ਤੇ ਘਰੀਆਂ; ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
englishTranslation: Day by day, hour by hour, life runs its course, and the body withers away.

gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ. ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ; ਤਾ ਕਉ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕਾਹੋ ॥
englishTranslation: That humble being, who knows even a little about loving devotional worship - what surprises are there for him?
Mortals may go to the Realm of Indra, or the Realm of Shiva,

gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ; ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
englishTranslation: Remember the Lord, remember the Lord, remember the Lord in meditation, O Siblings of Destiny.

gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ. ਮੋਹਿ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ; ਪੰਚਹੁ ਕਾ ਮਿਟ ਨਾਵਉ ॥
englishTranslation: I have brought the ten sensory organs under my control, and erased every trace of the five thieves.

gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਵਾੜਿ. ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ; ਬੇਲਿ ਬਾਲਹਾ. ਕਰਹਲਾ ॥
englishTranslation: As water is very precious in the desert, and the creeper weeds are dear to the camel,
First of all, the lotuses bloomed in the woods;
O Lord, You are the Purifier of sinners - this is Your innate nature.

gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਉ. ਨੈਨ ਅਵਿਲੋਕਨੋ; ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਾਨੀ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਾਖਉ ॥
englishTranslation: In my consciousness, I remember You in meditation; with my eyes, I behold You; I fill my ears with the Word of Your Bani, and Your Sublime Praise.
Your Name, Lord, is my adoration and cleansing bath.

gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬੈਸਿ. ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ; ਚਾਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
englishTranslation: He dwells deep within the nucleus of each and every heart. This is my seat and my home. I walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ. ਕਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ; ਮੁਰਗਾਈ ਨੈ ਸਾਣੇ ॥
englishTranslation: The lotus flower floats untouched upon the surface of the water, and the duck swims through the stream;

gurmukhi: ਹਾਟੀ ਬਾਟੀ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ; ਰੂਖਿ ਬਿਰਖਿ ਉਦਿਆਨੇ ॥
englishTranslation: "Away from stores and highways, we live in the woods, among plants and trees.

gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੋਗਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ; ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਖਿੰਥਾ ॥
englishTranslation: "Wear the robes of the sect of Yogis who follow Gorakh; put on the ear-rings, begging wallet and patched coat.
Let your mind turn away in detachment from the world, and let this be your begging bowl. Let the lessons of the five elements be your cap.
He is hidden within each and every heart. The Gurmukh is liberated.
Man is bound by evil-mindedness, and consumed by Maya, the serpent.
"Why have you left your house and become a wandering Udaasee?
"How have you changed the course of your life?

gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਕਵਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ; ਸੁੰਨ ਕਹਾ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
englishTranslation: "What can you tell us about the beginning? In what home did the absolute dwell then?

gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ; ਸੁੰਨ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਲੀਆ ॥
englishTranslation: We can only express a sense of wonder about the beginning. The absolute abided endlessly deep within Himself then.

gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੌ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਸੂਚੇ ਏਕ ਮਇਆ ॥
englishTranslation: We emerge from Truth, and merge into Truth again. The pure being merges into the One True Lord.
The Gurmukh lives in the Fear of God, the True Lord.
The Gurmukh speaks the unspoken wisdom.
The Gurmukh obtains the eight miraculous spiritual powers, and all wisdom.
Attuned to the Naam, they attain Sidh Gosht - conversation with the Siddhas.
The Gurmukh obtains the jewel, lovingly focused on the Lord.
The Gurmukh understands the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
englishTranslation: One who meets the Guru is carried across.
The comings and goings in reincarnation are ended for the Gurmukh.
"What is the root, the source of all? What teachings hold for these times?

gurmukhi: ਮੈਣ ਕੇ ਦੰਤ; ਕਿਉ ਖਾਈਐ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: "With teeth of wax, how can one chew iron?
Imbued with the True Fear of God, pride is taken away;
Giving voice to the Shabad, the moon of the mind is illuminated with infinity.

gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੁੰਨੰ. ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁੰਨੰ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ; ਸੁੰਨ ਮਸੁੰਨੰ ॥
englishTranslation: The absolute Lord is deep within; the absolute Lord is outside us as well. The absolute Lord totally fills the three worlds.
By practicing control over the nine gates, one attains perfect control over the Tenth Gate.
"Where is that place, where evil thoughts are destroyed?
One who possesses the merchandise, the wealth of the True Name,

gurmukhi: ਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਉ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਅਲਖੰ; ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
englishTranslation: That Shabad dwells deep within the nucleus of all beings. God is invisible; wherever I look, there I see Him.

gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ; ਪਵਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
englishTranslation: "The air is said to be the soul of the mind. But what does the air feed on?
By Guru's Grace, one is attuned to the Lord's Love.

gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੀਅਲੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
englishTranslation: When the mind becomes steady and stable, it abides in the heart, and then the Gurmukh realizes the root, the source of all.

gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਪੁਰਖਾ; ਕਿਤੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
englishTranslation: "How, in what way, was the world formed, O man? And what disaster will end it?"

gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ; ਜੋਗੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
englishTranslation: Without serving the True Guru, Yoga is not attained;

gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੂ ਅਉਧੂ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
englishTranslation: This is the essence of the Shabad - listen, you hermits and Yogis. Without the Name, there is no Yoga.
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ. ਰਾਇ ਬਲਵੰਡਿ ਤਥਾ ਸਤੈ ਡੂਮਿ ਆਖੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Vaar Of Raamkalee, Uttered By Satta And Balwand The Drummer:

gurmukhi: ਲਹਣੇ ਦੀ ਫੇਰਾਈਐ; ਨਾਨਕਾ. ਦੋਹੀ ਖਟੀਐ ॥
englishTranslation: Nanak proclaimed Lehna's succession - he earned it.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਮੰਨਣਾ; ਕੋ ਸਾਲੁ ਜਿਵਾਹੇ ਸਾਲੀ ॥
englishTranslation: He who did the work, is accepted as Guru; so which is better - the thistle or the rice?

gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿਂਓ. ਗੰਗ ਵਹਾਈਐ; ਦੁਨਿਆਈ ਆਖੈ. ਕਿ ਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: It is as if the Guru made the Ganges flow in the opposite direction, and the world wonders: what has he done?
Then, the True Guru, the son of Pheru, came to dwell at Khadoor.

gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਹਣਾ; ਸੋਈ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
englishTranslation: The same mark on the forehead, the same throne, and the same Royal Court.

gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਗੁਰੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ. ਤਿਨੈ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
englishTranslation: Blessed, blessed is Guru Raam Daas; He who created You, has also exalted You.

gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਗੇ. ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ; ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਆ ॥
englishTranslation: The four Gurus enlightened the four ages; the Lord Himself assumed the fifth form.

gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Raamkalee, The Word Of The Devotees. Kabeer Jee:

gurmukhi: ਗੁੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ. ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਹੂਆ; ਭਉ ਭਾਠੀ ਮਨ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
englishTranslation: Make spiritual wisdom the molasses, meditation the flowers, and the Fear of God the fire enshrined in your mind.

gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੋ. ਮੇਰੁ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਮੈ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
englishTranslation: You are my Sumayr Mountain, O my Lord and Master; I have grasped Your Support.

gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਮਾਨਉ ਦੂਤਾ ਡਾਨਉ; ਇਹ ਕੁਟਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
englishTranslation: I honor and obey the Saints, and punish the wicked; this is my duty as God's police officer.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਮੁਖ ਬੇਦੁ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ; ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨੁ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
englishTranslation: O Brahmin, how can you forget the One, from whose mouth the Vedas and the Gayitri prayer issured forth?

gurmukhi: ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ. ਅਨੰਤ ਡਾਰ ਸਾਖਾ; ਪੁਹਪ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਰਸ ਭਰੀਆ ॥
englishTranslation: There is a single tree, with countless branches and twigs; its flowers and leaves are filled with its juice.

gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੋਨਿ. ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਝੋਲੀ; ਪਤ੍ਰ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
englishTranslation: Make silence your ear-rings, and compassion your wallet; let meditation be your begging bowl.

gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਾਜ. ਸਿਰਜੇ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਜਨਮਿ ਕਵਨ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
englishTranslation: For what purpose were you created and brought into the world? What rewards have you received in this life?
Remembering Him in meditation, the door of liberation is found.

gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Raamkalee, Second House, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:
The moon and the sun are both the embodiment of light.

gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਹੁਸੀਆਰ ਬੇਦਾਰ; ਜਾਗਤ ਮੁਸੀਅਤ ਹਉ. ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
englishTranslation: People of the world, remain awake and aware. Even though you are awake, you are being robbed, O Siblings of Destiny.

gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
englishTranslation: The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, Raamkalee, First House:

gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ. ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਆਨੰਤਾ; ਗੀਤ ਕਬਿਤ. ਨ ਗਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
englishTranslation: There are countless Vedas, Puraanas and Shaastras; I do not sing their songs and hymns.

gurmukhi: ਮਾਇ. ਨ ਹੋਤੀ, ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ; ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
englishTranslation: When there was no mother and no father, no karma and no human body,
Raamkalee, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:
Raamkalee, The Word Of Baynee Jee:
Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Maalee Gauraa, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੋ ਬਾਪੁ ਮਾਧਉ, ਤੂ ਧਨੁ ਕੇਸੌ; ਸਾਂਵਲੀਓ ਬੀਠੁਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: O my Father, Lord of wealth, blessed are You, long-haired, dark-skinned, my darling. ||1||Pause||

gurmukhi: ਸਭੈ ਘਟ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੋਲੈ; ਰਾਮਾ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
englishTranslation: Within all hearts, the Lord speaks, the Lord speaks.
Raag Maaroo, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:
Raag Maaroo, First Mehl, Fifth House:
Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House, Dho-Padhay:
Maaroo, Anjulee ~ With Hands Cupped In Prayer, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Maaroo, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Maaroo, Third Mehl, Fifth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:
Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Ashtpadheeyaa:
Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:
Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Eighth House, Anjulees ~ With Hands Cupped In Prayer:

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:

gurmukhi: ਬਨਹਿ ਬਸੇ. ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜਉ ਲਉ ਮਨਹੁ. ਨ ਤਜਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Living in the forest, how will you find Him? Not until you remove corruption from your mind.

gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਰੀ; ਤਬ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਾਜ ॥
englishTranslation: You have riches and miraculous spiritual powers; so what business do you have with anyone else?

gurmukhi: ਉਦਕ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਲਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਖਿਆ; ਨਦੀ ਤਰੰਗ ਸਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
englishTranslation: Like drops of water in the water of the ocean, and like waves in the stream, I merge in the Lord.

gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮੑ. ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਹਉ; ਤਉ ਤੁਮ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
englishTranslation: If You keep me far away from You, then tell me, what is liberation?

gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੜ ਕੋਟ ਕੀਏ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ; ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ਸੋ ਰਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥
englishTranslation: Raawan made castles and fortresses of gold, but he had to abandon them when he left. ||1||

gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਗਾਵਾ. ਜੀਉ ਧਰ ਮਹਤਉ; ਬਸਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਕਿਰਸਾਨਾ ॥
englishTranslation: The body is a village, and the soul is the owner and farmer; the five farm-hands live there.

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:
O king, who will come to you?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Shabad Of Kabeer, Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Jai Dayv Jee:

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:
Tukhaari Chhant, First Mehl, Baarah Maahaa ~ The Twelve Months:
The rainbird cries out, "Pri-o! Beloved!", and the song-bird sings the Lord's Bani.

gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ. ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭਿੰਨੇ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
englishTranslation: Please listen, O my Beloved Lord - I am drenched with Your Love.
The Ambrosial Nectar rains down on us! Its drops are so delightful!
In the month of Chayt, the lovely spring has come, and the bumble bees hum with joy.
Vaisakhi is so pleasant; the branches blossom with new leaves.

gurmukhi: ਮਾਹੁ ਜੇਠੁ ਭਲਾ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ॥
englishTranslation: The month of Jayt'h is so sublime. How could I forget my Beloved?
The month of Aasaarh is good; the sun blazes in the sky.

gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣਿ. ਸਰਸ ਮਨਾ; ਘਣ ਵਰਸਹਿ ਰੁਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
englishTranslation: In Saawan, be happy, O my mind. The rainy season has come, and the clouds have burst into showers.

gurmukhi: ਭਾਦਉ. ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ; ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥
englishTranslation: In Bhaadon, the young woman is confused by doubt; later, she regrets and repents.

gurmukhi: ਅਸੁਨਿ. ਆਉ ਪਿਰਾ; ਸਾ ਧਨ. ਝੂਰਿ ਮੁਈ ॥
englishTranslation: In Assu, come, my Beloved; the soul-bride is grieving to death.

gurmukhi: ਕਤਕਿ. ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
englishTranslation: In Katak, that alone comes to pass, which is pleasing to the Will of God.

gurmukhi: ਮੰਘਰ ਮਾਹੁ ਭਲਾ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥
englishTranslation: The month of Maghar is good, for those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and merge in His Being.

gurmukhi: ਪੋਖਿ. ਤੁਖਾਰੁ ਪੜੈ; ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਰਸੁ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
englishTranslation: In Poh, the snow falls, and the sap of the trees and the fields dries up.

gurmukhi: ਮਾਘਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਈ; ਤੀਰਥੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
englishTranslation: In Maagh, I become pure; I know that the sacred shrine of pilgrimage is within me.
In Phalgun, her mind is enraptured, pleased by the Love of her Beloved.

gurmukhi: ਬੇ ਦਸ ਮਾਹ; ਰੁਤੀ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਭਲੇ ॥
englishTranslation: The twelve months, the seasons, the weeks, the days, the hours, the minutes and the seconds are all sublime,

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Kaydaaraa, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:

gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਬਨਜਿਆ ਕਾਂਸੀ ਤਾਂਬਾ; ਕਿਨਹੀ ਲਉਗ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Some deal in bronze and copper, some in cloves and betel nuts.

gurmukhi: ਰੀ ਕਲਵਾਰਿ, ਗਵਾਰਿ ਮੂਢ ਮਤਿ; ਉਲਟੋ ਪਵਨੁ ਫਿਰਾਵਉ ॥
englishTranslation: You barbaric brute, with your primitive intellect - reverse your breath and turn it inward.

gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕੇ ਲੀਨੇ; ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਏਕੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
englishTranslation: You are engrossed with unsatisfied sexual desire and unresolved anger; you do not know the State of the One Lord.

gurmukhi: ਟੇਢੀ ਪਾਗ ਟੇਢੇ ਚਲੇ; ਲਾਗੇ ਬੀਰੇ ਖਾਨ ॥
englishTranslation: Your turban is crooked, and you walk crooked; and now you have started chewing betel leaves.

gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਨ; ਅਪਨੀ ਨਉਬਤਿ ਚਲੇ ਬਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: The mortal beats the drum for a few days, and then he must depart.

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Kaydaaraa, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:
Raag Bhairao, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Raag Bhairao, Third Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:
Raag Bhairao, Fourth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:
Raag Bhairao, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, Second House:
Raag Bhairao, Fifth Mehl, Partaal, Third House:
Bhairao, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, Second House:
Bhairao, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
englishTranslation: Bhairao, The Word Of The Devotees, Kabeer Jee, First House:
Naked we come, and naked we go.
Brahma is polluted, and Indra is polluted.

gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਕਾ; ਕਿਬਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Let your mind be Mecca, and your body the temple of worship.
When the stream flows into the Ganges,
Some apply ceremonial marks to their foreheads, hold malas in their hands, and wear religious robes.
Turning away from the world, I have forgotten both my social class and ancestry.
No one respects the poor man.
Serving the Guru, devotional worship is practiced.

gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਕੀ ਪੁਰੀ; ਬਸੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: In the City of God, sublime understanding prevails.

gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੁਲਾਂ; ਜੋ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਰੈ ॥
englishTranslation: He alone is a Mullah, who struggles with his mind,

gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਮੀਨ; ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੇਧੇ ॥
englishTranslation: The fish in the water is attached to Maya.
As long as he cries out, Mine! Mine!,

gurmukhi: ਸਤਰਿ ਸੈਇ ਸਲਾਰ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਚਲਨ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ; ਊਹਾਂ ॥

englishTranslation: How can the beautiful fortress be conquered, O Siblings of Destiny?
The mother Ganges is deep and profound.
Bhairao, Kabeer Jee, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:
Millions of suns shine for Him,

gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
englishTranslation: Bhairao, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, First House:
One who stays away from others' wealth and others' spouses
Naam Dayv milked the brown cow,
I am crazy - the Lord is my Husband.

gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ; ਖੀਰਿ ਖਾਡ ਘੀਉ. ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
englishTranslation: Sometimes, people do not appreciate milk, sugar and ghee.
Laughing and playing, I came to Your Temple, O Lord.
Bhairao, Naam Dayv Jee, Second House:
The blind fool abandons the wife of his own home,

gurmukhi: ਸੰਡਾ ਮਰਕਾ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥ ਪੜੈ ਨਹੀ; ਹਮ ਹੀ ਪਚਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
englishTranslation: Sanda and Marka went and complained to Harnaakhash, "Your son does not read his lessons. We are tired of trying to teach him.

gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
englishTranslation: Bhairao, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee, Second House:

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Basant, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay, Dho-Thukay:
First Mehl, Basant Hindol, Second House:
Basant, Third Mehl, First House, Dho-Thukay:
Basant Hindol, Third Mehl, Second House:

englishTranslation: Basant, The Word Of The Devotees, Kabeer Jee, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Pandits, the Hindu religious scholars, are intoxicated, reading the Puraanas.
The wife gives birth to her husband.

gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਮਧੇ; ਮਦਨ ਚੋਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Within the body and mind are thieves like sexual desire,
There is one merchant and five traders.
Basant, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ. ਅਤਿ ਨੀਝਰ ਬਾਜੈ ॥ ਕਾਇਆ ਡੂਬੈ, ਕੇਸਵਾ ॥੧॥
englishTranslation: The tidal waves of greed constantly assault me. My body is drowning, O Lord. ||1||

gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਅਵਲਿ, ਧੂੜਿ ਮਣੀ; ਗਾਡੀ ਚਾਲਤੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Slowly at first, the body-cart loaded with dust starts to move.

englishTranslation: I beg for devotion to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; I have forsaken all other activities. ||1||Pause||
Gazing upon my Guru, I sing the Praises of my Beloved Lord.
My mind is neutral and detached;

englishTranslation: Vaar Of Saarang, Fourth Mehl, To Be Sung To The Tune Of Mehma-Hasna:

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Saarang, The Word Of The Devotees. Kabeer Jee:
I do not know the limits of Your Royal Ashram.
Saarang, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

gurmukhi: ਬਦਹੁ. ਕੀ ਨ, ਹੋਡ ਮਾਧਉ; ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Why not make a bet with me, O Lord of Wealth?
Says God: my slave is devoted only to me; he is in my very image.

gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਮਨ; ਹਰਿ, ਬਿਮੁਖਨ ਕੋ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
englishTranslation: O mind, do not even associate with those who have turned their backs on the Lord.

englishTranslation: Vaar Of Malaar, First Mehl, Sung To The Tune Of Rana Kailaash And Malda:

englishTranslation: Vaar Of Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl, Sung To The Tune Of The Ballad Of Musa:

gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕਾਨੜਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Raag Kaanraa, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:
Raag Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl, First House:

gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
englishTranslation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Bibhaas:

gurmukhi: ਬਿਭਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Bibhaas, Prabhaatee, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee:

gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Prabhaatee, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:
Prabhaatee, The Word Of Devotee Baynee Jee:

gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
englishTranslation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
englishTranslation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੰਤ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਨੇਹੰ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਸਨੇਹੰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਬਾਂਧਵਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Cursed is loving attachment to one's mother and father; cursed is loving attachment to one's siblings and relatives.
The body is false; its power is temporary.

gurmukhi: ਕਾਚ ਕੋਟੰ ਰਚੰਤਿ ਤੋਯੰ; ਲੇਪਨੰ ਰਕਤ ਚਰਮਣਹ ॥
englishTranslation: This fragile body-fortress is made up of water, plastered with blood and wrapped in skin.

gurmukhi: ਸੁਭੰਤ ਤੁਯੰ, ਅਚੁਤ ਗੁਣਗੵੰ; ਪੂਰਨੰ ਬਹੁਲੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
englishTranslation: O Glorious, Eternal and Imperishable, Perfect and Abundantly Compassionate,

gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗੀ ਪੇਖੰਤ. ਬਧਿਕ; ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇਣ, ਲਖੵ ਆਵਧਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Seeing the deer, the hunter aims his weapons.

gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੰ ਰਤੰ, ਹਿਤੰ ਮਇਆ; ਕੀਰਤੰ. ਕਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੁਆ ॥
englishTranslation: To be imbued and attuned to the Word of the Shabad; to be kind and compassionate; to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - these are the most worthwhile actions in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

gurmukhi: ਘਟੰਤ ਰੂਪੰ. ਘਟੰਤ ਦੀਪੰ; ਘਟੰਤ ਰਵਿ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ਗਗਨੰ ॥
englishTranslation: Beauty fades away, islands fade away, the sun, moon, stars and sky fade away.
Do not delay in practicing righteousness; delay in committing sins.

gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤ ਮੋਹੰ. ਅਲਪ ਬੁਧੵੰ; ਰਚੰਤਿ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ. ਸਾਹੰ ॥
englishTranslation: The person of shallow understanding is dying in emotional attachment; he is engrossed in pursuits of pleasure with his wife.

gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੰ ਤ ਮਰਣੰ, ਹਰਖੰ ਤ ਸੋਗੰ; ਭੋਗੰ ਤ ਰੋਗੰ ॥
englishTranslation: If there is birth, then there is death. If there is pleasure, then there is pain. If there is enjoyment, then there is disease.
By the Grace of God, genuine understanding comes to the mind.

gurmukhi: ਕਹੰਤ ਬੇਦਾ, ਗੁਣੰਤ ਗੁਨੀਆ; ਸੁਣੰਤ ਬਾਲਾ, ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
englishTranslation: The Vedas preach and recount God's Glories; people hear them by various ways and means.

gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ, ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਹ; ਨਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ, ਕਛੁ ਲੋਕ ਕਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Do not worry so much about your mother, father and siblings. Do not worry so much about other people.

gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਤੵ ਵਿਤੰ. ਅਨਿਤੵ ਚਿਤੰ. ਅਨਿਤੵ ਆਸਾ; ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ॥
englishTranslation: Wealth is temporary; conscious existence is temporary; hopes of all sorts are temporary.

gurmukhi: ਗਿਰੰਤ ਗਿਰਿ, ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਤਾਲੰ; ਜਲੰਤ ਦੇਦੀਪੵ ਬੈਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਰਹ ॥
englishTranslation: You may drop down from the mountains, and fall into the nether regions of the underworld, or be burnt in the blazing fire,

gurmukhi: ਘੋਰ ਦੁਖੵੰ, ਅਨਿਕ ਹਤੵੰ; ਜਨਮ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰੰ, ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੵਾਦੰ ॥
englishTranslation: Excruciating pain, countless killings, reincarnation, poverty and terrible misery

gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੰ; ਗੁਣ ਰਮੰਤ. ਅਘ ਖੰਡਨਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the darkness is illuminated. Dwelling on His Glorious Praises, the ugly sins are destroyed.

gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੰ. ਕਰੋਤਿ ਅਗ੍ਰਣੀਵਹ; ਨਿਰਾਸੰ, ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Those who were left behind - the Lord brings them to the front. He fulfills the hopes of the hopeless.

gurmukhi: ਅਧਰੰ ਧਰੰ ਧਾਰਣਹ; ਨਿਰਧਨੰ. ਧਨ ਨਾਮ ਨਰਹਰਹ ॥
englishTranslation: He gives Support to the unsupported. The Name of the Lord is the Wealth of the poor.

gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਸਮਰਥੰ. ਨਹ ਸੇਵਕੰ; ਨਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੰ ॥
englishTranslation: I have no power; I do not serve You, and I do not love You, O Supreme Sublime Lord God.

gurmukhi: ਭਰਣ ਪੋਖਣ ਕਰੰਤ ਜੀਆ; ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਛਾਦਨ ਦੇਵੰਤ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
englishTranslation: The Lord feeds and sustains all living beings; He blesses them gifts of restful peace and fine clothes.
The kings of the earth are eating up the blessings of the good karma of their past lives.

gurmukhi: ਰਮਣੰ ਕੇਵਲੰ ਕੀਰਤਨੰ; ਸੁਧਰਮੰ ਦੇਹ ਧਾਰਣਹ ॥
englishTranslation: To sing the Kirtan of God's Praises is the righteous duty incurred by taking birth in this human body.

gurmukhi: ਤਿਰਸਕਾਰ. ਨਹ ਭਵੰਤਿ; ਨਹ ਭਵੰਤਿ ਮਾਨ ਭੰਗਨਹ ॥
englishTranslation: They pay no attention to dishonor or disrespect.

gurmukhi: ਸੈਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਸਮੂਹ, ਸੂਰ ਅਜਿਤੰ; ਸੰਨਾਹੰ ਤਨਿ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾਹ ॥
englishTranslation: The Holy people are an invincible army of spiritual warriors; their bodies are protected by the armor of humility.

gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ, ਗੰਧਰਬ ਨਗਰੰ; ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਯਾ, ਰਚਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Misled by evil-mindedness, mortals are engrossed in the mirage of the illusory world, like the passing shade of a tree.

gurmukhi: ਕੰਠ ਰਮਣੀਯ, ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮਾਲਾ; ਹਸਤ ਊਚ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਧਾਰਣੀ ॥
englishTranslation: The mala around my neck is the chanting of the Lord's Name. The Love of the Lord is my silent chanting.

gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੀਣਸੵ. ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੰਤ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਸਟਣਹ ॥
englishTranslation: That mortal who lacks the Guru's Mantra - cursed and contaminated is his life.
Whoever contemplates the Lord's Lotus Feet, and enshrines His Name within the heart,

gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਧਨੰ ਰੂਪੰ; ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਰਾਜਨਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Wealth and beauty are not so difficult to obtain. Paradise and royal power are not so difficult to obtain.

gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤਹ ਤਤਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰ; ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਮਰਤ. ਪਯਾਲ ਲੋਕਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Wherever I look, I see the Lord, whether in this world, in paradise, or the nether regions of the underworld.

gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਯਾ ਭਯੰਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੰ; ਦ੍ਰੁਸਟਾਂ ਸਖਾ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Poison is transformed into nectar, and enemies into friends and companions.

gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੀਲ, ਮਮੰ ਸੀਲੰ; ਸਰਬ ਪਾਵਨ ਮਮ ਪਾਵਨਹ ॥
englishTranslation: He blesses all with humility; He has blessed me with humility as well. He purifies all, and He has purified me as well.

gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਦੇਵਹ; ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨਹ ॥
englishTranslation: The moon-god is not cool and calm, nor is the white sandalwood tree.

gurmukhi: ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੰ; ਧੵਾਨੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Through the Mantra of the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, one meditates on the All-pervading Lord.

gurmukhi: ਅਜਾ ਭੋਗੰਤ. ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੰ; ਬਸੰਤੇ ਸਮੀਪਿ ਕੇਹਰਹ ॥
englishTranslation: The goat enjoys eating fruits and roots, but if it lives near a tiger, it is always anxious.

gurmukhi: ਛਲੰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੰ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨੰ; ਅਪਰਾਧੰ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਮਲੰ ॥
englishTranslation: Fraud, false accusations, millions of diseases, sins and the filthy residues of evil mistakes;

gurmukhi: ਤਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਰਮਣ ਸੀਲ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥
englishTranslation: In the Sanctuary of the Kind-hearted Lord, our Transcendent Lord and Master, we are carried across.

gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਗਮ ਸਥਾਨ, ਸੁਗਮੰ; ਮਹਾ ਦੂਖ. ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖਣਹ ॥
englishTranslation: The most difficult place becomes easy, and the worst pain turns into pleasure.

gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਅਜਿਤ ਸੂਰ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮੰ; ਅਤਿ ਬਲਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਰਦਨਹ ॥
englishTranslation: O emotional attachment, you are the invincible warrior of the battlefield of life; you totally crush and destroy even the most powerful.

gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਕਾਮੰ. ਨਰਕ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੰ; ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਵਣਹ ॥
englishTranslation: O sexual desire, you lead the mortals to hell; you make them wander in reincarnation through countless species.

gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਕਲਿ ਮੂਲ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੰ; ਕਦੰਚ ਕਰੁਣਾ. ਨ ਉਪਰਜਤੇ ॥
englishTranslation: O anger, you are the root of conflict; compassion never rises up in you.

gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਲੋਭਾ, ਲੰਪਟ ਸੰਗ ਸਿਰਮੋਰਹ; ਅਨਿਕ ਲਹਰੀ ਕਲੋਲਤੇ ॥
englishTranslation: O greed, you cling to even the great, assaulting them with countless waves.

gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਮੂਲੰ; ਅਹੰਕਾਰੰ ਪਾਪਾਤਮਾ ॥
englishTranslation: O egotism, you are the root of birth and death and the cycle of reincarnation; you are the very soul of sin.

gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਨਾਥ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ; ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਗਦ ਗੁਰੋ ॥
englishTranslation: O Lord of the Universe, Master of the Breath of life, Treasure of Mercy, Guru of the World.

gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣੰ; ਰਮਣੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
englishTranslation: I have come to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Lotus Feet, where I sing the Kirtan of His Praises.

gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਮਸ੍ਤਕ ਰਖੵਾ. ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ; ਹਸ੍ਤ ਕਾਯਾ ਰਖੵਾ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰਹ ॥
englishTranslation: The Supreme Lord God has procted my head and forehead; the Transcendent Lord has protected my hands and body.

gurmukhi: ਜੇਨ ਕਲਾ. ਧਾਰਿਓ ਆਕਾਸੰ; ਬੈਸੰਤਰੰ ਕਾਸਟ ਬੇਸਟੰ ॥
englishTranslation: His Power supports the sky, and locks fire within wood.

gurmukhi: ਗੁਸਾਂਈ ਗਰਿਸ੍ਟ ਰੂਪੇਣ; ਸਿਮਰਣੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਵਣਹ ॥
englishTranslation: The Lord of the World is Supremely Beautiful; His Meditation is the Life of all.

gurmukhi: ਮਸਕੰ. ਭਗਨੰਤ ਸੈਲੰ; ਕਰਦਮੰ, ਤਰੰਤ ਪਪੀਲਕਹ ॥
englishTranslation: The mosquito pierces the stone, the ant crosses the swamp,

gurmukhi: ਤਿਲਕ ਹੀਣੰ. ਜਥਾ ਬਿਪ੍ਰਾ; ਅਮਰ ਹੀਣੰ. ਜਥਾ ਰਾਜਨਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Like a Brahmin without a sacred mark on his forehead, or a king without the power of command,

gurmukhi: ਨ ਸੰਖੰ. ਨ ਚਕ੍ਰੰ; ਨ ਗਦਾ. ਨ ਸਿਆਮੰ ॥
englishTranslation: God has no conch-shell, no religious mark, no paraphernalia; he does not have blue skin.

gurmukhi: ਉਦਿਆਨ ਬਸਨੰ ਸੰਸਾਰੰ; ਸਨਬੰਧੀ, ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਸਿਆਲ ਖਰਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Living in the world, it is like a wild jungle. One's relatives are like dogs, jackals and donkeys.

gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੰਤ. ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲਹ; ਸਗਲੵੰ ਰੋਗ ਖੰਡਣਹ ॥
englishTranslation: When the Lord of the Universe grants His Grace, all illnesses are cured.

gurmukhi: ਅਚੇਤ ਮੂੜਾ. ਨ ਜਾਣੰਤ; ਘਟੰਤ ਸਾਸਾ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਤੇ ॥
englishTranslation: The thoughtless fool does not know that each day, his breaths are being used up.

gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਜਿਹਬੇ. ਹੇ ਰਸਗੇ; ਮਧੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਤੁਯੰ ॥
englishTranslation: O tongue, you love to enjoy the sweet delicacies.
Those who are proud, and intoxicated with the pleasures of sex,

gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਣੰ. ਤ ਮੇਰੰ; ਸਹਕੰ. ਤ ਹਰੀਅੰ ॥
englishTranslation: The blade of grass becomes a mountain, and the barren land becomes green.

gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰਣੰ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਰਮ ਜਿ ਪੂਰਣਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Associating with the Brahmin, one is saved, if his actions are perfect and God-like.

gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਹਿਰਣੰ. ਬਹੁ ਵਿਘਨ ਕਰਣੰ; ਉਚਰਣੰ. ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਕਹ ॥
englishTranslation: The mortal steals the wealth of others, and makes all sorts of problems; his preaching is only for his own livelihood.

gurmukhi: ਮਤੇ ਸਮੇਵ ਚਰਣੰ; ਉਧਰਣੰ. ਭੈ ਦੁਤਰਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Those who are intoxicated and absorbed in the Lord's Lotus Feet are saved from the terrifying world-ocean.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਕਉ; ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਹਸਨੇਹਾਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, everyone laughs at my social class.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਡਗਮਗ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ; ਕਹਾ ਡੁਲਾਵਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, why do you stumble? Why does your soul waver?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਬਨੇ; ਊਪਰਿ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, earrings made of gold and studded with jewels,

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਐਸਾ ਏਕੁ ਆਧੁ; ਜੋ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, rare is such a person, who remains dead while yet alive.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਹਉ ਮੂਆ; ਪਾਛੈ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, on the day when I die, afterwards there shall be bliss.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਭ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਬੁਰੇ; ਹਮ ਤਜਿ. ਭਲੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I am the worst of all. Everyone else is good.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਆਈ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਪਹਿ; ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਭੇਸ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, she came to me in various forms and disguises.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੋਈ ਮਾਰੀਐ; ਜਿਹ ਮੂਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, kill only that, which, when killed, shall bring peace.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕਾਰੀਆ; ਕਾਰੇ ਊਭੇ ਜੰਤ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the night is dark, and men go about doing their dark deeds.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਚੰਦਨ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਭਲਾ; ਬੇੜੑਿਓ ਢਾਕ ਪਲਾਸ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the sandalwood tree is good, even though it is surrounded by weeds.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਬਾਂਸੁ ਬਡਾਈ ਬੂਡਿਆ; ਇਉ. ਮਤ ਡੂਬਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the bamboo is drowned in its egotistical pride. No one should drown like this.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਦੀਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਿਉ; ਦੁਨੀ. ਨ ਚਾਲੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the mortal loses his faith, for the sake of the world, but the world shall not go along with him in the end.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਹ ਜਹ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਿਓ; ਕਉਤਕ ਠਾਓ ਠਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, wherever I go, I see wonders everywhere.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਝੁੰਗੀਆ ਭਲੀ; ਭਠਿ ਕੁਸਤੀ ਗਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the dwelling of the Saints is good; the dwelling of the unrighteous burns like an oven.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੰਤ ਮੂਏ ਕਿਆ ਰੋਈਐ; ਜੋ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, why cry at the death of a Saint? He is just going back to his home.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਾਕਤੁ ਐਸਾ ਹੈ; ਜੈਸੀ ਲਸਨ ਕੀ ਖਾਨਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the faithless cynic is like a piece of garlic.
Kabeer, Maya is the butter-churn, and the breath is the churning-stick.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲਨੀ; ਪਵਨੁ ਵਹੈ ਹਿਵ ਧਾਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, Maya is the butter-churn; the breath flows like ice water.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਾਇਆ ਚੋਰਟੀ; ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਿ ਲਾਵੈ ਹਾਟਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, Maya is the thief, which breaks in and plunders the store.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੂਖੁ ਨ ਏਂਹ ਜੁਗਿ; ਕਰਹਿ ਜੁ ਬਹੁਤੈ ਮੀਤ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, peace does not come in this world by making lots of friends.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਿਸੁ ਮਰਨੇ ਤੇ ਜਗੁ ਡਰੈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the world is afraid of death - that death fills my mind with bliss.

gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ; ਕਬੀਰਾ ਗਾਂਠਿ. ਨ ਖੋਲੑ ॥
englishTranslation: The Treasure of the Lord is obtained, O Kabeer, but do not undo its knot.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ; ਜਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, be in love with only that one, whose Master is the Lord.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਇਕ ਸਿਉ ਕੀਏ; ਆਨ. ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, when you are in love with the One Lord, duality and alienation depart.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਗੁ ਕਾਜਲ ਕੀ ਕੋਠਰੀ; ਅੰਧ ਪਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the world is a room filled with black soot; the blind fall into its trap.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਇਗਾ; ਸਕਹੁ. ਤ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਹੋਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, this body shall perish; save it, if you can.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਇਗਾ; ਕਵਨੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, this body shall perish; place it on the path.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਰਤਾ ਮਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੂਆ; ਮਰਿ. ਭੀ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, dying, dying, the whole world has to die, and yet, none know how to die.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ; ਹੋਇ ਨ. ਬਾਰੈ ਬਾਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, it is so difficult to obtain this human body; it does not just come over and over again.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਤੁਹੀ. ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤੂ; ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, you are Kabeer; your name means great.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਝੰਖੁ, ਨ ਝੰਖੀਐ; ਤੁਮਰੋ ਕਹਿਓ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, do not struggle in stubborn pride; nothing happens just because you say so.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕਸਉਟੀ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ; ਝੂਠਾ ਟਿਕੈ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, no one who is false can withstand the Touchstone of the Lord.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਊਜਲ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਕਾਪਰੇ; ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, some wear gaudy robes, and chew betel leaves and betel nuts.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਬੇੜਾ ਜਰਜਰਾ; ਫੂਟੇ ਛੇਂਕ ਹਜਾਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the boat is old, and it has thousands of holes.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਹਾਡ ਜਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਲਾਕਰੀ; ਕੇਸ ਜਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਘਾਸੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the bones burn like wood, and the hair burns like straw.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਗਰਬੁ, ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ; ਚਾਮ ਲਪੇਟੇ ਹਾਡ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, do not be so proud of your bones wrapped up in skin.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਗਰਬੁ, ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ; ਊਚਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਵਾਸੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, do not be so proud of your tall mansions.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਗਰਬੁ, ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ; ਰੰਕੁ. ਨ ਹਸੀਐ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, do not be so proud, and do not laugh at the poor.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਗਰਬੁ, ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ; ਦੇਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਰੰਗ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, do not be so proud, looking at your beautiful body.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਲੂਟਨਾ ਹੈ, ਤ ਲੂਟਿ ਲੈ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹੈ ਲੂਟਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, if you must rob and plunder, then plunder the plunder of the Lord's Name.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਐਸਾ ਕੋਈ, ਨ ਜਨਮਿਓ; ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਵੈ ਆਗਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, there is no one born, who burns his own home,

gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਹੈ ਲਰਿਕਾ ਬੇਚਈ; ਲਰਿਕੀ ਬੇਚੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, how rare are those who sell their son and sell their daughter

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਇਹ ਚੇਤਾਵਨੀ; ਮਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, let me remind you of this. Do not be skeptical or cynical.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮੈ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪੜਿਬੋ ਭਲੋ; ਪੜਿਬੇ ਸਿਉ ਭਲ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, at first, I thought learning was good; then I thought Yoga was better.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਲੋਗੁ ਕਿ ਨਿੰਦੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ; ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ. ਨਾਹੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, how can the wretched people slander me? They have no wisdom or intelligence.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਕੈ ਘਾਘਰੈ; ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਗਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the robe of the stranger-soul has caught fire on all four sides.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਖਿੰਥਾ ਜਲਿ ਕੋਇਲਾ ਭਈ; ਖਾਪਰੁ ਫੂਟ ਮਫੂਟ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the cloth has been burnt and reduced to charcoal, and the begging bowl is shattered into pieces.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਥੋਰੈ ਜਲਿ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ; ਝੀਵਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the fish is in the shallow water; the fisherman has cast his net.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਮੁੰਦੁ, ਨ ਛੋਡੀਐ; ਜਉ ਅਤਿ ਖਾਰੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, do not leave the ocean, even if it is very salty.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਨਿਗੁਸਾਂਏਂ ਬਹਿ ਗਏ; ਥਾਂਘੀ. ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, those who have no guru are washed away. No one can help them.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਬੈਸਨਉ ਕੀ ਕੂਕਰਿ ਭਲੀ; ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਬੁਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, even the dog of a devotee is good, while the mother of the faithless cynic is bad.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਹਰਨਾ ਦੂਬਲਾ; ਇਹੁ ਹਰੀਆਰਾ ਤਾਲੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the deer is weak, and the pool is lush with green vegetation.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਗੰਗਾ ਤੀਰ ਜੁ ਘਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ; ਪੀਵਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨੀਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, some make their homes on the banks of the Ganges, and drink pure water.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਭਇਆ; ਜੈਸਾ ਗੰਗਾ ਨੀਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, my mind has become immaculate, like the waters of the Ganges.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਹਰਦੀ ਪੀਅਰੀ; ਚੂੰਨਾਂ ਊਜਲ ਭਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, tumeric is yelow, and lime is white.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਹਰਦੀ ਪੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰੈ; ਚੂਨ ਚਿਹਨੁ. ਨ ਰਹਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, tumeric has lost its yellow color, and no trace of lime's whiteness remains.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸੰਕੁਰਾ; ਰਾਈ ਦਸਏਂ ਭਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the door of liberation is very narrow, less than the width of a mustard seed.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤੁਠਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, if I meet such a True Guru, who mercifully blesses me with the gift,

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਨਾ ਮੋੁਹਿ ਛਾਨਿ. ਨ ਛਾਪਰੀ; ਨਾ ਮੋੁਹਿ ਘਰੁ. ਨਹੀ ਗਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I have no hut or hovel, no house or village.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮੁਹਿ ਮਰਨੇ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ਹੈ; ਮਰਉ ਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I long to die; let me die at the Lord's Door.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕੀਆ, ਨ ਕਰਹਿਗੇ; ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I have not done anything; I shall not do anything; my body cannot do anything.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੁਪਨੈ ਹੂ ਬਰੜਾਇ ਕੈ; ਜਿਹ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, if someone utters the Name of the Lord even in dreams,

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਾਟੀ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਪੂਤਰੇ; ਮਾਨਸੁ ਰਾਖਿਓੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, we are puppets of clay, but we take the name of mankind.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਹਿਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਘਾਲਿਆ; ਆਪੁ ਪੀਸਾਇ ਪੀਸਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I have made myself into henna, and I grind myself into powder.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਿਹ ਦਰਿ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤਿਅਹੁ; ਹਟਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ. ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, that door, through which people never stop coming and going

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਡੂਬਾ ਥਾ ਪੈ ਉਬਰਿਓ; ਗੁਨ ਕੀ ਲਹਰਿ ਝਬਕਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I was drowning, but the waves of virtue saved me in an instant.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਪਾਪੀ, ਭਗਤਿ. ਨ ਭਾਵਈ; ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ. ਨ ਸੁਹਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the sinner does not like devotion to the Lord; he does not appreciate worship.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਬੈਦੁ ਮੂਆ. ਰੋਗੀ ਮੂਆ; ਮੂਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the physician is dead, and the patient is dead; the whole world is dead.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਰਾਮੁ, ਨ ਧਿਆਇਓ; ਮੋਟੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਖੋਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I have not meditated on the Lord; such is the bad habit I have developed.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਐਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਪਰੀ; ਮਨ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਤੁ ਕੀਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, it came to pass, that I did whatever I pleased.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਰਸ ਕੋ ਗਾਂਡੋ ਚੂਸੀਐ; ਗੁਨ ਕਉ ਮਰੀਐ ਰੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the mortals suck at the sugar cane, for the sake of the sweet juice. They should work just as hard for virtue.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਗਾਗਰਿ ਜਲ ਭਰੀ; ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲੑਿ. ਜੈਹੈ ਫੂਟਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the pitcher is full of water; it will break, today or tomorrow.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕੂਕਰੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ; ਮੁਤੀਆ ਮੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I am the Lord's dog; Moti is my name.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਪਨੀ ਕਾਠ ਕੀ; ਕਿਆ ਦਿਖਲਾਵਹਿ ਲੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, why do you show other people your rosary beads?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਬਿਰਹੁ ਭੁਯੰਗਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ; ਮੰਤੁ. ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the snake of separation from the Lord abides within my mind; it does not respond to any mantra.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਪਾਰਸ ਚੰਦਨੈ; ਤਿਨੑ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਸੁਗੰਧ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the philosopher's stone and sandalwood oil have the same good quality.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਮ ਕਾ ਠੇਂਗਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਹੈ; ਓਹੁ. ਨਹੀ ਸਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, Death's club is terrible; it cannot be endured.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਬੈਦੁ ਕਹੈ ਹਉ ਹੀ ਭਲਾ; ਦਾਰੂ ਮੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the physician says that he alone is good, and all the medicine is under his control.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਨਉਬਤਿ ਆਪਨੀ; ਦਿਨ ਦਸ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, take your drum and beat it for ten days.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦਹਿ ਮਸੁ ਕਰਉ; ਕਲਮ ਕਰਉ ਬਨਰਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, if I could change the seven seas into ink and make all the vegetation my pen,

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਾਤਿ ਜੁਲਾਹਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸੇ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, what can my lowly status as a weaver do to me? The Lord dwells in my heart.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਐਸਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ; ਮੰਦਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਜਰਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, will anyone set fire to his home

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਐਸਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ; ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਫੂਕਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, will anyone burn his own body?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਤੀ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਚਿਹ ਚੜੀ; ਸੁਨੁ ਹੋ ਬੀਰ ਮਸਾਨ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the widow mounts the funeral pyre and cries out, "Listen, O brother funeral pyre.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਭਇਓ; ਉਡਿ ਉਡਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the mind has become a bird; it soars and flies in the ten directions.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਤੇ; ਪਾਇਓ ਸੋਈ ਠਉਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, you have found that place which you were seeking.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਾਰੀ ਮਰਉ ਕੁਸੰਗ ਕੀ; ਕੇਲੇ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜੁ ਬੇਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I have been ruined and destroyed by bad company, like the banana plant near the thorn bush.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਭਾਰ ਪਰਾਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਚਰੈ; ਚਲਿਓ ਚਾਹੈ ਬਾਟ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the mortal wants to walk on the path, carrying the load of others' sins on his head.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਬਨ ਕੀ ਦਾਧੀ ਲਾਕਰੀ; ਠਾਢੀ ਕਰੈ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the forest is burning; the tree standing in it is crying out,

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਏਕ ਮਰੰਤੇ, ਦੁਇ ਮੂਏ; ਦੋਇ ਮਰੰਤਹ. ਚਾਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, when one died, two were dead. When two died, four were dead.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜਗੁ ਢੂੰਢਿਆ; ਕਹੂੰ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਠਉਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I have seen and observed, and searched all over the world, but I have found no place of rest anywhere.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰੀਐ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ; ਅੰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਹੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, associate with the Holy people, who will take you to Nirvaanaa in the end.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਜਾਨਿ ਕੈ; ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I contemplate the Lord in the world; I know that He is permeating the world.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਆਸਾ ਕਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ; ਅਵਰੈ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, place your hopes in the Lord; other hopes lead to despair.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਿਖ ਸਾਖਾ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਕੀਏ; ਕੇਸੋ ਕੀਓ. ਨ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer has made many students and disciples, but he has not made God his friend.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕਾਰਨੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ; ਜਉ ਰਾਮੁ. ਨ ਕਰੈ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, what can the poor creature do, if the Lord does not give him assistance?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਅਵਰਹ ਕਉ ਉਪਦੇਸਤੇ; ਮੁਖ ਮੈ. ਪਰਿ ਹੈ ਰੇਤੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, those who only preach to others - sand falls into their mouths.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਹਉ; ਜਉ ਕੀ ਭੂਸੀ ਖਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I will remain in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, even if I have only coarse bread to eat.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ; ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨ ਦੂਨਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, in the Saadh Sangat, love for the Lord doubles day by day.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਨੁ ਮੂੰਡਿਆ ਨਹੀ; ਕੇਸ ਮੁੰਡਾਏ ਕਾਂਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, you have not shaved your mind, so why do you shave your head?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਰਾਮੁ, ਨ ਛੋਡੀਐ; ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਜਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, do not abandon the Lord; your body and wealth shall go, so let them go.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜੋ ਹਮ ਜੰਤੁ ਬਜਾਵਤੇ; ਟੂਟਿ ਗਈਂ ਸਭ ਤਾਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, all the strings of the instrument I played are broken.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਾਇ ਮੂੰਡਉ. ਤਿਹ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ; ਜਾ ਤੇ ਭਰਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, shave the mother of that guru, who does not take away one's doubt.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜੇਤੇ ਪਾਪ ਕੀਏ; ਰਾਖੇ ਤਲੈ ਦੁਰਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, whatever sins the mortal has committed, he tries to keep hidden under cover.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ; ਪਾਲਿਓ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, you have given up meditating on the Lord, and you have raised a large family.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ; ਰਾਤਿ ਜਗਾਵਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, those who give up meditation on the Lord, and get up at night to wake the spirits of the dead,

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ. ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ; ਅਹੋਈ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the woman who gives up meditation on the Lord, and observes the ritual fast of Ahoi,

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਅਤਿ ਘਨੀ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, it is the most clever wisdom, to chant and meditate on the Lord in the heart.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੋੁਈ ਮੁਖੁ ਧੰਨਿ ਹੈ; ਜਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, blessed is that mouth, which utters the Lord's Name.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੋਈ ਕੁਲ ਭਲੀ; ਜਾ ਕੁਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, that family is good, in which the Lord's slave is born.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਹੈ ਗਇ ਬਾਹਨ, ਸਘਨ ਘਨ; ਲਾਖ ਧਜਾ ਫਹਰਾਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, some have lots of horses, elephants and carriages, and thousands of banners waving.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਿਓ; ਮਾਂਦਲੁ ਕੰਧ ਚਢਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I have wandered all over the world, carrying the drum on my shoulder.

gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੋਤੀ ਬੀਥਰੇ; ਅੰਧਾ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਆਇ ॥
englishTranslation: The pearls are scattered on the road; the blind man comes along.

gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਾ ਬੰਸੁ. ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾ; ਉਪਜਿਓ ਪੂਤੁ ਕਮਾਲੁ ॥
englishTranslation: My family is drowned, O Kabeer, since the birth of my son Kamaal.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਾਧੂ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਨੇ ਜਾਈਐ; ਸਾਥਿ. ਨ ਲੀਜੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, go out to meet the holy man; do not take anyone else with you.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਜਿਹ ਜੇਵਰੀ; ਤਿਹ ਮਤ ਬੰਧਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, do not bind yourself with that chain, which binds the whole world.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਹੰਸੁ ਉਡਿਓ, ਤਨੁ ਗਾਡਿਓ; ਸੋਝਾਈ ਸੈਨਾਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the soul-swan is flying away, and the body is being buried, and still he makes gestures.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਨੈਨ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ, ਤੁਝ ਕਉ; ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਉ ਤੁਅ ਨਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer: with my eyes, I see You, Lord; with my ears, I hear Your Name.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੁਰਗ ਨਰਕ ਤੇ, ਮੈ ਰਹਿਓ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I have been spared from heaven and hell, by the Grace of the True Guru.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਮਉਜ ਕੋ; ਕਹਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਨਮਾਨ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, how can I even describe the extent of the joy of the Lord's Lotus Feet?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਕਿਹ ਕਹਉ; ਕਹੇ. ਨ ਕੋ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, how can I describe what I have seen? No one will believe my words.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਚੁਗੈ ਚਿਤਾਰੈ ਭੀ ਚੁਗੈ; ਚੁਗਿ ਚੁਗਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the flamingo pecks and feeds, and remembers her chicks.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਅੰਬਰ ਘਨਹਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ; ਬਰਖਿ. ਭਰੇ ਸਰ ਤਾਲ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the sky is overcast and cloudy; the ponds and lakes are overflowing with water.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਚਕਈ ਜਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਬੀਛੁਰੈ; ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the chakvi duck is separated from her love through the night, but in the morning, she meets him again.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਰੈਨਾਇਰ ਬਿਛੋਰਿਆ; ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਖ ਮਝੂਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer: O conch shell, remain in the ocean.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੂਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ; ਜਾਗੁ. ਰੋਇ ਭੈ ਦੁਖ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, what are you doing sleeping? Wake up and cry in fear and pain.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੂਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ; ਉਠਿ ਕਿ. ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, what are you doing sleeping? Why not rise up and meditate on the Lord?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੂਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ; ਬੈਠਾ ਰਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਜਾਗੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, what are you doing sleeping? Wake up, and sit up.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਗੈਲ, ਨ ਛੋਡੀਐ; ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, do not leave the Society of the Saints; walk upon this Path.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗੁ, ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ; ਦੂਰਹਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਭਾਗਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, do not associate with the faithless cynics; run far away from them.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ. ਰਾਮੁ, ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ; ਜਰਾ ਪਹੂੰਚਿਓ ਆਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, you have not contemplated the Lord, and now old age has overtaken you.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕਾਰਨੁ ਸੋ ਭਇਓ; ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the Creator does whatever He pleases.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ਫਲਨਿ; ਪਾਕਨਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਆਂਬ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the fruit trees are bearing fruit, and the mangoes are becoming ripe.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਮੋਲਿ ਲੇ; ਮਨਹਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, some buy idols and worship them; in their stubborn-mindedness, they make pilgrimages to sacred shrines.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਪਾਹਨੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਕੀਆ; ਪੂਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, someone sets up a stone idol and all the world worships it as the Lord.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕਾਗਦ ਕੀ ਓਬਰੀ; ਮਸੁ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the paper is the prison, and the ink of rituals are the bars on the windows.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕਾਲਿ ਕਰੰਤਾ. ਅਬਹਿ ਕਰੁ; ਅਬ ਕਰਤਾ. ਸੁਇ ਤਾਲ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, that which you have to do tomorrow - do it today instead; and that which you have to do now - do it immediately!

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਐਸਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਜੈਸੀ ਧੋਈ ਲਾਖ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I have seen a person, who is as shiny as washed wax.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮੇਰੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਉ; ਜਮੁ. ਨ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਸਕਾਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the Messenger of Death shall not compromise my understanding.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰੁ. ਕਸਤੂਰੀ ਭਇਆ; ਭਵਰ ਭਏ ਸਭ ਦਾਸ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the Lord is like musk; all His slaves are like bumble bees.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਗਹਗਚਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਕੈ; ਕਾਂਠੈ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਓ, ਰਾਮੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the mortal has fallen into the grip of family life, and the Lord has been set aside.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਾਕਤ ਤੇ ਸੂਕਰ ਭਲਾ; ਰਾਖੈ ਆਛਾ ਗਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, even a pig is better than the faithless cynic; at least the pig keeps the village clean.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉਡੀ ਜੋਰਿ ਕੈ; ਜੋਰੇ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the mortal gathers wealth, shell by shell, accumulating thousands and millions.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਬੈਸਨੋ ਹੂਆ, ਤ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ; ਮਾਲਾ ਮੇਲੀਂ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, what good is it to become a devotee of Vishnu, and wear four malas?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਰੋੜਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਬਾਟ ਕਾ; ਤਜਿ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, let yourself be a pebble on the path; abandon your egotistical pride.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਰੋੜਾ ਹੂਆ. ਤ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ; ਪੰਥੀ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, what good would it be, to be a pebble? It would only hurt the traveller on the path.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਖੇਹ ਹੂਈ, ਤਉ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ; ਜਉ ਉਡਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਅੰਗ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, what then, if one could become dust? It is blown up by the wind, and sticks to the body.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਪਾਨੀ ਹੂਆ, ਤ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ; ਸੀਰਾ ਤਾਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, what then, if one could become water? It becomes cold, then hot.

gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਭਵਨ ਕਨਕਾਮਨੀ; ਸਿਖਰਿ ਧਜਾ ਫਹਰਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: The banners wave above the lofty mansions, filled with gold and beautiful women.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਪਾਟਨ ਤੇ ਊਜਰੁ ਭਲਾ; ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਹ ਠਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the wilderness is better than a city, if the Lord's devotees live there.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਗੰਗ ਜਮੁਨ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰੇ; ਸਹਜ ਸੁੰਨ ਕੇ ਘਾਟ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, between the Ganges and Jamunaa Rivers, on the shore of Celestial Silence,

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜੈਸੀ ਉਪਜੀ ਪੇਡ ਤੇ; ਜਉ ਤੈਸੀ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਓੜਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, if the mortal continues to love the Lord in the end, as he pledged in the beginning,

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ. ਏਕੁ ਅਚੰਭਉ ਦੇਖਿਓ; ਹੀਰਾ ਹਾਟ ਬਿਕਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I saw a strange and wonderful thing. A jewel was being sold in a store.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ. ਜਹਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ. ਤਹ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ; ਜਹਾ ਝੂਠੁ. ਤਹ ਪਾਪੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, where there is spiritual wisdom, there is righteousness and Dharma. Where there is falsehood, there is sin.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਾਇਆ ਤਜੀ. ਤ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ; ਜਉ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਜਿਆ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, what good is it to give up Maya, if the mortal does not give up his pride?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਾਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਸਬਦੁ ਜੁ ਬਾਹਿਆ ਏਕੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the True Guru has met me; He aimed the Arrow of the Shabad at me.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਾਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ, ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ; ਜਉ ਸਿਖਾ ਮਹਿ ਚੂਕ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, what can the True Guru do, when His Sikhs are at fault?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਹੈ ਗੈ ਬਾਹਨ ਸਘਨ ਘਨ; ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤੀ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the wife of the king has all sorts of horses, elephants and carriages.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਨਾਰੀ, ਕਿਉ ਨਿੰਦੀਐ; ਕਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਰੀ ਕਉ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, why do you slander the wife of the king? Why do you honor the slave of the Lord?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਥੂਨੀ ਪਾਈ ਥਿਤਿ ਭਈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੰਧੀ ਧੀਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, with the Support of the Lord's Pillar, I have become steady and stable.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ. ਜਨ ਜਉਹਰੀ; ਲੇ ਕੈ ਮਾਂਡੈ ਹਾਟ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the Lord is the Diamond, and the Lord's humble servant is the jeweller who has set up his shop.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕਾਮ ਪਰੇ, ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ; ਐਸਾ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਨਿਤ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, you remember the Lord in meditation, only when the need arises. You should remember Him all the time.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੇਵਾ ਕਉ ਦੁਇ ਭਲੇ; ਏਕੁ ਸੰਤੁ. ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, it is good to perform selfless service for two - the Saints and the Lord.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਿਹ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਗਏ; ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰੀ ਬਹੀਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the crowds follow the path which the Pandits, the religious scholars, have taken.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੇ ਮੂਆ; ਚਾਲਤ ਕੁਲ ਕੀ ਕਾਨਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the mortal dies of his worldly troubles and pain, after worrying about his family.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਡੂਬਹਿਗੋ, ਰੇ ਬਾਪੁਰੇ; ਬਹੁ ਲੋਗਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਨਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, you shall drown, you wretched being, from worrying about what other people think.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਭਲੀ ਮਧੂਕਰੀ; ਨਾਨਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਜੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, even dry bread, made of various grains, is good.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਦਾਵੈ ਦਾਝਨੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਹੈ; ਨਿਰਦਾਵੈ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਸੰਕ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, those who brag, shall burn. Those who do not brag remain carefree.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਪਾਲਿ ਸਮੁਹਾ, ਸਰਵਰੁ ਭਰਾ; ਪੀ. ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ਨੀਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the pool is filled to overflowing, but no one can drink the water from it.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਪਰਭਾਤੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਖਿਸਹਿ; ਤਿਉ ਇਹੁ ਖਿਸੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, just as the stars disappear at dawn, so shall this body disappear.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕੋਠੀ ਕਾਠ ਕੀ; ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਗਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the wooden house is burning on all sides.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੁ; ਕਾਗਦ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, give up your skepticism; let your papers float away.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੰਤੁ, ਨ ਛਾਡੈ ਸੰਤਈ; ਜਉ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਅਸੰਤ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the Saint does not forsake his Saintly nature, even though he meets with millions of evil-doers.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਭਇਆ; ਪਾਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, my mind is cooled and soothed; I have become God-conscious.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਾਰੀ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰ ਕੀ; ਜਾਨੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, no one knows the Play of the Creator Lord.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਭਲੀ ਭਈ ਜੋ ਭਉ ਪਰਿਆ; ਦਿਸਾ ਗਈਁ ਸਭ ਭੂਲਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, it is good that I feel the Fear of God; I have forgotten everything else.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ. ਧੂਰਿ ਸਕੇਲਿ ਕੈ; ਪੁਰੀਆ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the body is a pile of dust, collected and packed together.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸੂਰਜ ਚਾਂਦ ਕੈ; ਉਦੈ ਭਈ ਸਭ ਦੇਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, bodies are like the rising and setting of the sun and the moon.

gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਅਨਭਉ. ਤਹ ਭੈ ਨਹੀ; ਜਹ ਭਉ. ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Where the Fearless Lord is, there is no fear; where there is fear, the Lord is not there.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਿਨਹੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਨਹੀ; ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖ ਨੀਦ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, those who do not know anything, pass their lives in peaceful sleep.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਾਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਆ; ਪੀਰ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਅਉਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, those who are beaten cry a lot; but the cries of the pain of separation are different.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਚੋਟ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਸੇਲ ਕੀ; ਲਾਗਤ. ਲੇਇ ਉਸਾਸ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the stroke of a lance is easy to bear; it takes away the breath.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮੁਲਾਂ ਮੁਨਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਢਹਿ; ਸਾਂਈ. ਨ ਬਹਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer: O Mullah, why do you climb to the top of the minaret? The Lord is not hard of hearing.

gurmukhi: ਸੇਖ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ; ਕਿਆ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Why does the Shaykh bother to go on pilgrimage to Mecca, if he is not content with himself?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਅਲਹ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, worship the Lord Allah; meditating in remembrance on Him, troubles and pains depart.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜੋਰੀ ਕੀਏ ਜੁਲਮੁ ਹੈ; ਕਹਤਾ ਨਾਉ ਹਲਾਲੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, to use force is tyranny, even if you call it legal.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਖੂਬੁ ਖਾਨਾ ਖੀਚਰੀ; ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੋਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the dinner of beans and rice is excellent, if it is flavored with salt.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਗੁਰੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਬ ਜਾਨੀਐ; ਮਿਟੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਨ ਤਾਪ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, one is known to have been touched by the Guru, only when his emotional attachment and physical illnesses are eradicated.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਰਾਮ ਕਹਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਹੈ; ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ॥
