englishTranslation: Kabeer, it does make a difference, how you chant the Lord's Name, 'Raam'. This is something to consider.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਰਾਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਹੁ; ਕਹਿਬੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, use the word 'Raam', only to speak of the All-pervading Lord. You must make that distinction.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਾ ਘਰ ਸਾਧ, ਨ ਸੇਵੀਅਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, those houses in which neither the Holy nor the Lord are served

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਗੂੰਗਾ ਹੂਆ ਬਾਵਰਾ; ਬਹਰਾ ਹੂਆ ਕਾਨ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I have become mute, insane and deaf.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੂਰਮੇ; ਬਾਹਿਆ ਬਾਨੁ ਜੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the True Guru, the Spiritual Warrior, has shot me with His Arrow.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੂੰਦ ਅਕਾਸ ਕੀ; ਪਰਿ ਗਈ ਭੂਮਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the pure drop of water falls from the sky, onto the dirty ground.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੂੰਦ ਅਕਾਸ ਕੀ; ਲੀਨੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the pure drop of water falls from the sky, and mixes with the dust.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਹਜ ਕਾਬੇ ਹਉ ਜਾਇ ਥਾ; ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I was going on a pilgrimage to Mecca, and God met me on the way.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ; ਕੇਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I went to Mecca - how many times, Kabeer?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜੀਅ ਜੁ ਮਾਰਹਿ, ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਕਹਤੇ ਹਹਿ ਜੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, they oppress living beings and kill them, and call it proper.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜੋਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜੁਲਮੁ ਹੈ; ਲੇਇ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, it is tyranny to use force; the Lord shall call you to account.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਨਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ; ਜਉ ਦਿਲ ਸੂਚੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, it is easy to render your account, if your heart is pure.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਧਰਤੀ ਅਰੁ ਆਕਾਸ ਮਹਿ; ਦੁਇ. ਤੂੰ ਬਰੀ ਅਬਧ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer: O duality, you are mighty and powerful in the earth and the sky.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮੇਰਾ ਮੁਝ ਮਹਿ, ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ; ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ. ਸੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, nothing is mine within myself. Whatever there is, is Yours, O Lord.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ, ਤੂ ਹੂਆ; ਮੁਝ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਾ ਨ. ਹੂੰ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, repeating, "You, You", I have become like You. Nothing of me remains in myself.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਬਿਕਾਰਹ ਚਿਤਵਤੇ; ਝੂਠੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਸ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, those who think of evil and entertain false hopes

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ; ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, whoever meditates in remembrance on the Lord, he alone is happy in this world.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਘਾਣੀ ਪੀੜਤੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I was being crushed like sesame seeds in the oil-press, but the True Guru saved me.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਟਾਲੈ ਟੋਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਗਇਆ; ਬਿਆਜੁ ਬਢੰਤਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, my days have passed, and I have postponed my payments; the interest on my account continues to increase.

gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ; ਕਹੈ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
englishTranslation: Trilochan says, O Naam Dayv, Maya has enticed you, my friend.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕੀਚੜਿ ਆਟਾ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ; ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਆਇਓ ਹਾਥ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the flour has fallen into the mud; nothing has come into my hands.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਨੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਭ ਬਾਤ; ਜਾਨਤ ਹੀ ਅਉਗਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the mortal knows everything, and knowing, he still makes mistakes.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਸਿਉ; ਬਰਜੈ ਲੋਗੁ ਅਜਾਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I am in love with the All-knowing Lord; the ignorant ones try to hold me back.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਰਿ; ਕਾਹੇ ਮਰਹੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, why kill yourself for your love of decorations of your home and mansion?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜੋ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਵਉ, ਨਾ ਕਰੈ; ਕਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਚਿਤਵੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, whatever I wish for does not happen. What can I accomplish by merely thinking?

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਚੀ ਕਾਰਵੀ; ਕੇਵਲ ਕਾਚੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the body is like a clay vessel or a brittle metal pot.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕੇਸੋ ਕੇਸੋ ਕੂਕੀਐ; ਨ ਸੋਈਐ ਅਸਾਰ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, chant the Name of the Beautifully-haired Lord; do not sleep unaware.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕਾਇਆ ਕਜਲੀ ਬਨੁ ਭਇਆ; ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ. ਮਯ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the body is a banana forest, and the mind is an intoxicated elephant.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਕੋਥਰੀ; ਪਾਰਖ ਆਗੈ ਖੋਲਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the Lord's Name is the jewel, and the mouth is the purse; open this purse to the Appraiser.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਨਹੀ; ਪਾਲਿਓ ਕਟਕੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the mortal does not know the Lord's Name, but he has raised a very large family.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਆਖੀ ਕੇਰੇ ਮਾਟੁਕੇ; ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਗਈ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, in the blink of an eye, moment by moment, life is passing by.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਤਰਵਰ ਰੂਪੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ; ਫਲ ਰੂਪੀ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the Lord is the tree, and disillusionment with the world is the fruit.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਐਸਾ ਬੀਜੁ ਬੋਇ; ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਸ ਫਲੰਤ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, plant the seeds of such a plant, which shall bear fruit throughout the twelve months,

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਦਾਤਾ ਤਰਵਰੁ, ਦਯਾ ਫਲੁ; ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਵੰਤ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the Great Giver is the tree, which blesses all with the fruit of compassion.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤੀ; ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the mortal finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, if he has such destiny written upon his forehead.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਏਕ ਘੜੀ, ਆਧੀ ਘਰੀ; ਆਧੀ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਆਧ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, whether is is for an hour, half an hour, or half of that,

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਭਾਂਗ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ, ਸੁਰਾ ਪਾਨਿ; ਜੋ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਖਾਂਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, those mortals who consume marijuana, fish and wine

gurmukhi: ਨੀਚੇ ਲੋਇਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਉ; ਲੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, I keep my eyes lowered, and enshrine my Friend within my heart.

gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਜਾਮ, ਚਉਸਠਿ ਘਰੀ; ਤੁਅ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਰਹੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Twenty-four hours a day, every hour, my soul continues to look to You, O Lord.

gurmukhi: ਸੁਨੁ ਸਖੀ. ਪੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਸੈ; ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੈ ਕਿ ਪੀਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Listen, O my companions: my soul dwells in my Beloved, and my Beloved dwells in my soul.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਬਾਮਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਜਗਤ ਕਾ; ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, the Brahmin may be the guru of the world, but he is not the Guru of the devotees.

gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਖਾਂਡੁ. ਰੇਤੁ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਖਰੀ; ਹਾਥੀ ਚੁਨੀ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: The Lord is like sugar, scattered in the sand; the elephant cannot pick it up.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਉ ਤੁਹਿ ਸਾਧ, ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੀ; ਸੀਸੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, if you desire to play the game of love with the Lord, then cut off your head, and make it into a ball.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਉ ਤੁਹਿ ਸਾਧ, ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੀ; ਪਾਕੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, if you desire to play the game of love with the Lord, play it with someone with committment.

gurmukhi: ਢੂੰਢਤ ਡੋਲਹਿ. ਅੰਧ ਗਤਿ; ਅਰੁ ਚੀਨਤ ਨਾਹੀ, ਸੰਤ ॥
englishTranslation: Searching, the mortal stumbles like a blind person, and does not recognize the Saint.

gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਹੀਰਾ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ; ਕਰਹਿ. ਆਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
englishTranslation: Forsaking the Diamond of the Lord, the mortals put their hopes in another.

gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਉ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ. ਤ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰੁ; ਨਾਹੀ ਤ. ਕਰੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Kabeer, if you live the householder's life, then practice righteousness; otherwise, you might as well retire from the world.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਦਰ ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਗਾਖੜੀ; ਚਲਾਂ ਦੁਨੀਆਂ ਭਤਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, it is so difficult to become a humble Saint at the Lord's Door.

gurmukhi: ਕਿਝੁ. ਨ ਬੁਝੈ, ਕਿਝੁ. ਨ ਸੁਝੈ; ਦੁਨੀਆ ਗੁਝੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: I know nothing; I understand nothing. The world is a smouldering fire.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਤਿਲ ਥੋੜੜੇ; ਸੰਮਲਿ ਬੁਕੁ ਭਰੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, if I had known that I had so few sesame seeds, I would have been more careful with them in my hands.

gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਲੜੁ ਛਿਜਣਾ; ਪੀਡੀ ਪਾਈਂ ਗੰਢਿ ॥
englishTranslation: If I had known that my robe would come loose, I would have tied a tighter knot.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਜੇ ਤੂ ਅਕਲਿ ਲਤੀਫੁ; ਕਾਲੇ ਲਿਖੁ. ਨ ਲੇਖ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, if you have a keen understanding, then do not write black marks against anyone else.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਜੋ ਤੈ ਮਾਰਨਿ ਮੁਕੀਆਂ; ਤਿਨੑਾ. ਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਘੁੰਮਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, do not turn around and strike those who strike you with their fists.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਜਾਂ ਤਉ ਖਟਣ ਵੇਲ; ਤਾਂ ਤੂ ਰਤਾ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਿਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, when there was time for you to earn good karma, you were in love with the world instead.

gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੁ ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਜੁ ਥੀਆ; ਦਾੜੀ ਹੋਈ ਭੂਰ ॥
englishTranslation: See, Fareed, what has happened: your beard has become grey.

gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੁ ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਜਿ ਥੀਆ; ਸਕਰ ਹੋਈ ਵਿਸੁ ॥
englishTranslation: See, Fareed, what has happened: sugar has become poison.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੀਣੀਆਂ; ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਰੀਣੇ ਕੰਨ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, my eyes have become weak, and my ears have become hard of hearing.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਕਾਲਂ‍ੀ ਜਿਨੀ, ਨ ਰਾਵਿਆ; ਧਉਲੀ ਰਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, those who did not enjoy their Spouse when their hair was black - hardly any of them enjoy Him when their hair turns grey.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਜਿਨੑ ਲੋਇਣ, ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ; ਸੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਮੈ ਡਿਠੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, those eyes which have enticed the world - I have seen those eyes.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਕੂਕੇਦਿਆ ਚਾਂਗੇਦਿਆ; ਮਤੀ ਦੇਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, they shouted and yelled, and constantly gave good advice.
Fareed, become the grass on the path,

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਖਾਕੁ, ਨ ਨਿੰਦੀਐ; ਖਾਕੂ ਜੇਡੁ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, do not slander the dust; noting is as great as dust.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਜਾ ਲਬੁ, ਤਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿਆ; ਲਬੁ. ਤ ਕੂੜਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, when there is greed, what love can there be? When there is greed, love is false.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਜੰਗਲੁ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਭਵਹਿ; ਵਣਿ ਕੰਡਾ ਮੋੜੇਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, why do you wander from jungle to jungle, crashing through the thorny trees?

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਇਨੀ ਨਿਕੀ ਜੰਘੀਐ; ਥਲ ਡੂੰਗਰ ਭਵਿਓਮੑਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, with these small legs, I crossed deserts and mountains.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਰਾਤੀ ਵਡੀਆਂ; ਧੁਖਿ ਧੁਖਿ ਉਠਨਿ ਪਾਸ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, the nights are long, and my sides are aching in pain.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਜੇ ਮੈ ਹੋਦਾ ਵਾਰਿਆ; ਮਿਤਾ ਆਇੜਿਆਂ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, if I had been there when my friend came, I would have made myself a sacrifice to him.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਲੋੜੈ ਦਾਖ ਬਿਜਉਰੀਆਂ; ਕਿਕਰਿ ਬੀਜੈ ਜਟੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, the farmer plants acacia trees, and wishes for grapes.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਗਲੀਏ ਚਿਕੜੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਘਰੁ; ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, the path is muddy, and the house of my Beloved is so far away.

gurmukhi: ਭਿਜਉ ਸਿਜਉ ਕੰਬਲੀ; ਅਲਹ ਵਰਸਉ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
englishTranslation: My blanket is soaked, drenched with the downpour of the Lord's Rain.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਮੈ ਭੋਲਾਵਾ ਪਗ ਦਾ; ਮਤੁ ਮੈਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, I was worried that my turban might become dirty.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਸਕਰ ਖੰਡੁ ਨਿਵਾਤ ਗੁੜੁ; ਮਾਖਿਓੁ ਮਾਂਝਾ ਦੁਧੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed: sugar cane, candy, sugar, molasses, honey and buffalo's milk

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਰੋਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਠ ਕੀ; ਲਾਵਣੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਭੁਖ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, my bread is made of wood, and hunger is my appetizer.

gurmukhi: ਰੁਖੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ; ਠੰਢਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪੀਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Eat dry bread, and drink cold water.

gurmukhi: ਅਜੁ. ਨ ਸੁਤੀ ਕੰਤ ਸਿਉ; ਅੰਗੁ ਮੁੜੇ ਮੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: This night, I did not sleep with my Husband Lord, and now my body is suffering in pain.

gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਢੋਈ. ਨਾ ਲਹੈ; ਪੇਈਐ. ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: She finds no place of rest in her father-in-law's home, and no place in her parents' home either.

gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ; ਕੰਤੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥
englishTranslation: In her father-in-law's home hereafter, and in her parents' home in this world, she belongs to her Husband Lord. Her Husband is Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

gurmukhi: ਨਾਤੀ ਧੋਤੀ ਸੰਬਹੀ; ਸੁਤੀ ਆਇ ਨਚਿੰਦੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Bathing, washing and decorating herself, she comes and sleeps without anxiety.

gurmukhi: ਜੋਬਨ ਜਾਂਦੇ. ਨਾ ਡਰਾਂ; ਜੇ ਸਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: I am not afraid of losing my youth, as long as I do not lose the Love of my Husband Lord.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਚਿੰਤ ਖਟੋਲਾ ਵਾਣੁ ਦੁਖੁ; ਬਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛਾਵਣ ਲੇਫੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, anxiety is my bed, pain is my mattress, and the pain of separation is my blanket and quilt.

gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਹਾ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਆਖੀਐ; ਬਿਰਹਾ ਤੂ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Many talk of the pain and suffering of separation; O pain, you are the ruler of all.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਏ ਵਿਸੁ ਗੰਦਲਾ; ਧਰੀਆਂ ਖੰਡੁ ਲਿਵਾੜਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, these are poisonous sprouts coated with sugar.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਚਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਹੰਢਿ ਕੈ; ਚਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਸੰਮਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, the hours of the day are lost wandering around, and the hours of the night are lost in sleep.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵਾਜੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ; ਕਿਉ ਡਿਠੋ ਘੜੀਆਲੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, you have gone to the Lord's Door. Have you seen the gong there?

gurmukhi: ਘੜੀਏ ਘੜੀਏ ਮਾਰੀਐ; ਪਹਰੀ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Each and every hour, it is beaten; it is punished every day.

gurmukhi: ਬੁਢਾ ਹੋਆ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦੁ; ਕੰਬਣਿ ਲਗੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Shaykh Fareed has grown old, and his body has begun to tremble.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਬਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਐ ਬੈਸਣਾ; ਸਾਂਈ ਮੁਝੈ. ਨ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed begs, O Lord, do not make me sit at another's door.

gurmukhi: ਕੰਧਿ ਕੁਹਾੜਾ. ਸਿਰਿ ਘੜਾ; ਵਣਿ ਕੈ ਸਰੁ. ਲੋਹਾਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: With the axe on his shoulder, and a bucket on his head, the blacksmith is ready to cut down the tree.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਇਕਨਾ ਆਟਾ ਅਗਲਾ; ਇਕਨਾ. ਨਾਹੀ ਲੋਣੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, some have lots of flour, while others do not even have salt.

gurmukhi: ਪਾਸਿ ਦਮਾਮੇ ਛਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ; ਭੇਰੀ ਸਡੋ ਰਡ ॥
englishTranslation: Drums were beaten in their honor, there were canopies above their heads, and bugles announced their coming.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ; ਉਸਾਰੇਦੇ ਭੀ ਗਏ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, those who built houses, mansions and lofty buildings, are also gone.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਖਿੰਥੜਿ ਮੇਖਾ ਅਗਲੀਆ; ਜਿੰਦੁ. ਨ ਕਾਈ ਮੇਖ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, there are many seams on the patched coat, but there are no seams on the soul.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਦੁਹੁ ਦੀਵੀ ਬਲੰਦਿਆ; ਮਲਕੁ ਬਹਿਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, the two lamps are lit, but death has come anyway.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਵੇਖੁ ਕਪਾਹੈ ਜਿ ਥੀਆ; ਜਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਥੀਆ, ਤਿਲਾਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, look at what has happened to the cotton and the sesame seed,

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਕੰਨਿ ਮੁਸਲਾ. ਸੂਫੁ ਗਲਿ; ਦਿਲਿ ਕਾਤੀ. ਗੁੜੁ ਵਾਤਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, you wear your prayer shawl on your shoulders and the robes of a Sufi; your words are sweet, but there is a dagger in your heart.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਰਤੀ ਰਤੁ, ਨ ਨਿਕਲੈ; ਜੇ ਤਨੁ ਚੀਰੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, not even a drop of blood would issue forth, if someone cut my body.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਸੋਈ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਢੂਢਿ ਲਹੁ; ਜਿਥਹੁ ਲਭੀ ਵਥੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, seek that sacred pool, in which the genuine article is found.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਨੰਢੀ. ਕੰਤੁ, ਨ ਰਾਵਿਓ; ਵਡੀ ਥੀ. ਮੁਈਆਸੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, when she is young, she does not enjoy her Husband. When she grows up, she dies.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਸਿਰੁ ਪਲਿਆ, ਦਾੜੀ ਪਲੀ; ਮੁਛਾਂ ਭੀ ਪਲੀਆਂ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, your hair has turned grey, your beard has turned grey, and your moustache has turned grey.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਕੋਠੇ ਧੁਕਣੁ ਕੇਤੜਾ; ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦੜੀ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, how long can you run on the rooftop? You are asleep to your Husband Lord - give it up!

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ; ਏਤੁ. ਨ ਲਾਏ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, houses, mansions and balconies - do not attach your consciousness to these.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾਲੁ, ਨ ਲਾਇ; ਮਰਗ ਸਤਾਣੀ, ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, do not focus on mansions and wealth; center your consciousness on death, your powerful enemy.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਜਿਨੑੀ ਕੰਮੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਗੁਣ; ਤੇ ਕੰਮੜੇ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, those deeds which do not bring merit - forget about those deeds.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ; ਦਿਲ ਦੀ ਲਾਹਿ ਭਰਾਂਦਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, work for your Lord and Master; dispel the doubts of your heart.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਕਾਲੇ ਮੈਡੇ ਕਪੜੇ; ਕਾਲਾ ਮੈਡਾ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, my clothes are black, and my outfit is black.

gurmukhi: ਤਤੀ ਤੋਇ. ਨ ਪਲਵੈ; ਜੇ ਜਲਿ ਟੁਬੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
englishTranslation: The crop which is burnt will not bloom, even if it is soaked in water.

gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਤਾ ਚਾਉ; ਵੀਵਾਹੀ ਤਾਂ ਮਾਮਲੇ ॥
englishTranslation: When she is a virgin, she is full of desire; but when she is married, then her troubles begin.

gurmukhi: ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਛਪੜੀ; ਆਇ ਉਲਥੇ ਹੰਝ ॥
englishTranslation: The swans have landed in a small pond of salt water.

gurmukhi: ਹੰਸੁ ਉਡਰਿ ਕੋਧ੍ਰੈ ਪਇਆ; ਲੋਕੁ ਵਿਡਾਰਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: The swans fly away, and land in the fields of grain. The people go to chase them away.

gurmukhi: ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਈਆਂ ਪੰਖੀਆਂ; ਜਿਨੑੀ ਵਸਾਏ ਤਲ ॥
englishTranslation: The birds which lived in the pools have flown away and left.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਇਟ ਸਿਰਾਣੇ, ਭੁਇ ਸਵਣੁ; ਕੀੜਾ ਲੜਿਓ ਮਾਸਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, a stone will be your pillow, and the earth will be your bed. The worms shall eat into your flesh.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਭੰਨੀ ਘੜੀ ਸਵੰਨਵੀ; ਟੁਟੀ ਨਾਗਰ ਲਜੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, your beautiful body shall break apart, and the subtle thread of the breath shall be snapped.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਭੰਨੀ ਘੜੀ ਸਵੰਨਵੀ; ਟੂਟੀ ਨਾਗਰ ਲਜੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, your beautiful body shall break apart, and the subtle thread of the breath shall be snapped.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਬੇ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ਕੁਤਿਆ; ਏਹ. ਨ ਭਲੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed: O faithless dog, this is not a good way of life.

gurmukhi: ਉਠੁ ਫਰੀਦਾ, ਉਜੂ ਸਾਜਿ; ਸੁਬਹ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Rise up, Fareed, and cleanse yourself; chant your morning prayer.

gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਾਈ. ਨਾ ਨਿਵੈ; ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਾਂਇ ॥
englishTranslation: That head which does not bow to the Lord - what is to be done with that head?

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਕਿਥੈ ਤੈਡੇ ਮਾਪਿਆ; ਜਿਨੑੀ ਤੂ ਜਣਿਓਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, where are your mother and father, who gave birth to you?

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਮਨੁ ਮੈਦਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ; ਟੋਏ ਟਿਬੇ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, flatten out your mind; smooth out the hills and valleys.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਜਿ ਦਿਹਿ ਨਾਲਾ ਕਪਿਆ; ਜੇ ਗਲੁ ਕਪਹਿ ਚੁਖ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, if on that day when my umbilical cord was cut, my throat had been cut instead,

gurmukhi: ਚਬਣ ਚਲਣ ਰਤੰਨ; ਸੇ ਸੁਣੀਅਰ ਬਹਿ ਗਏ ॥
englishTranslation: My teeth, feet, eyes and ears have stopped working.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਬੁਰੇ ਦਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਸਾ ਮਨਿ. ਨ ਹਢਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, answer evil with goodness; do not fill your mind with anger.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਪੰਖ ਪਰਾਹੁਣੀ; ਦੁਨੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਬਾਗੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, the bird is a guest in this beautiful world-garden.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਰਾਤਿ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਵੰਡੀਐ; ਸੁਤਿਆ ਮਿਲੈ. ਨ ਭਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, musk is released at night. Those who are sleeping do not receive their share.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਮੈ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਮੁਝ ਕੂ; ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਐ ਜਗਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, I thought that I was in trouble; the whole world is in trouble!

gurmukhi: ਕੰਧੀ ਵਹਣ. ਨ ਢਾਹਿ; ਤਉ ਭੀ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਵਣਾ ॥
englishTranslation: O river, do not destroy your banks; you too will be asked to give your account.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਡੁਖਾ ਸੇਤੀ. ਦਿਹੁ ਗਇਆ; ਸੂਲਾਂ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, the day passes painfully; the night is spent in anguish.

gurmukhi: ਲੰਮੀ ਲੰਮੀ ਨਦੀ ਵਹੈ; ਕੰਧੀ ਕੇਰੈ ਹੇਤਿ ॥
englishTranslation: The river flows on and on; it loves to eat into its banks.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਗਲਂ‍ੀ ਸੁ ਸਜਣ ਵੀਹ; ਇਕੁ ਢੂੰਢੇਦੀ. ਨ ਲਹਾਂ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, there are dozens who say they are friends; I search, but I cannot find even one.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਭਉਕਣਾ; ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਦੁਖੀਐ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, this body is always barking. Who can stand this constant suffering?

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਰਬ ਖਜੂਰੀ ਪਕੀਆਂ; ਮਾਖਿਅ. ਨਈ ਵਹੰਨੑਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, God's dates have ripened, and rivers of honey flow.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਤਨੁ ਸੁਕਾ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਥੀਆ; ਤਲੀਆਂ ਖੂੰਡਹਿ ਕਾਗ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, my withered body has become a skeleton; the crows are pecking at my palms.

gurmukhi: ਕਾਗਾ ਕਰੰਗ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ; ਸਗਲਾ ਖਾਇਆ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
englishTranslation: The crows have searched my skeleton, and eaten all my flesh.

gurmukhi: ਕਾਗਾ ਚੂੰਡਿ. ਨ ਪਿੰਜਰਾ; ਬਸੈ ਤ. ਉਡਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: O crow, do not peck at my skeleton; if you have landed on it, fly away.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਗੋਰ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ, ਸਡੁ ਕਰੇ; ਨਿਘਰਿਆ. ਘਰਿ ਆਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, the poor grave calls out, "O homeless one, come back to your home.

gurmukhi: ਏਨੀ ਲੋਇਣੀ ਦੇਖਦਿਆ; ਕੇਤੀ ਚਲਿ ਗਈ ॥
englishTranslation: These eyes have seen a great many leave.

gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ. ਮੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ; ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: God says, "If you reform yourself, you shall meet me, and meeting me, you shall be at peace.

gurmukhi: ਕੰਧੀ ਉਤੈ ਰੁਖੜਾ; ਕਿਚਰਕੁ ਬੰਨੈ ਧੀਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: How long can the tree remain implanted on the river-bank?

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਮਹਲ ਨਿਸਖਣ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ; ਵਾਸਾ ਆਇਆ ਤਲਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, the mansions are vacant; those who lived in them have gone to live underground.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਮਉਤੈ ਦਾ ਬੰਨਾ, ਏਵੈ ਦਿਸੈ; ਜਿਉ ਦਰੀਆਵੈ ਢਾਹਾ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, the shore of death looks like the river-bank, being eroded away.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਦਰੀਆਵੈ ਕੰਨੑੈ ਬਗੁਲਾ; ਬੈਠਾ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, the crane perches on the river bank, playing joyfully.

gurmukhi: ਸਾਢੇ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮਣ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ; ਚਲੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਨਿ ॥
englishTranslation: The body is nourished by water and grain.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਪੰਖੀਆ; ਜੰਗਲਿ ਜਿੰਨੑਾ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, I am a sacrifice to those birds which live in the jungle.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਰੁਤਿ ਫਿਰੀ ਵਣੁ ਕੰਬਿਆ; ਪਤ ਝੜੇ ਝੜਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, the seasons change, the woods shake and the leaves drop from the trees.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਪਾੜਿ ਪਟੋਲਾ ਧਜ ਕਰੀ; ਕੰਬਲੜੀ ਪਹਿਰੇਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, I have torn my clothes to tatters; now I wear only a rough blanket.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਤਿਨਾ ਮੁਖ ਡਰਾਵਣੇ; ਜਿਨਾ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਓਨੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, the faces of those who forget the Lord's Name are dreadful.

gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਪਿਛਲ ਰਾਤਿ, ਨ ਜਾਗਿਓਹਿ; ਜੀਵਦੜੋ ਮੁਇਓਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Fareed, if you do not awaken in the early hours before dawn, you are dead while yet alive.

gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਫੁਲੜਾ; ਫਲੁ ਭੀ ਪਛਾ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
englishTranslation: The first watch of the night brings flowers, and the later watches of the night bring fruit.

gurmukhi: ਦਾਤੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੰਦੀਆ; ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
englishTranslation: The gifts are from our Lord and Master; who can force Him to bestow them?

gurmukhi: ਢੂਢੇਦੀਏ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਕੂ; ਤਉ ਤਨਿ. ਕਾਈ ਕੋਰ ॥
englishTranslation: You search for your Husband Lord; you must have some fault in your body.

gurmukhi: ਸਬਰ ਮੰਝ ਕਮਾਣ; ਏ ਸਬਰੁ ਕਾ ਨੀਹਣੋ ॥
englishTranslation: Within yourself, make patience the bow, and make patience the bowstring.

gurmukhi: ਸਬਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਬਰੀ; ਤਨੁ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਲੇਨੑਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Those who are patient abide in patience; in this way, they burn their bodies.

gurmukhi: ਸਬਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ; ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਬੰਦਾ ਦਿੜੁ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Let patience be your purpose in life; implant this within your being.
Fareed, it is difficult to be a dervish - a Holy Saint; it is easier to love bread when it is buttered.

gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਤਪੈ ਤਨੂਰ ਜਿਉ; ਬਾਲਣੁ ਹਡ ਬਲੰਨੑਿ ॥
englishTranslation: My body is cooking like an oven; my bones are burning like firewood.

gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ. ਨ ਤਪਾਇ ਤਨੂਰ ਜਿਉ; ਬਾਲਣੁ ਹਡ. ਨ ਬਾਲਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Do not heat up your body like an oven, and do not burn your bones like firewood.

gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਸਜਣਾ; ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈਡੇ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
englishTranslation: I search for my Friend, but my Friend is already with me.

gurmukhi: ਹੰਸਾ. ਦੇਖਿ ਤਰੰਦਿਆ; ਬਗਾ ਆਇਆ ਚਾਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Seeing the swans swimming, the cranes became excited.

gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਵਡ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੈ; ਤਾਂ ਮੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
englishTranslation: I knew him as a great swan, so I associated with him.

gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਬਗੁਲਾ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਧਰੇ ॥
englishTranslation: Who is a swan, and who is a crane, if God blesses him with His Glance of Grace?
There is only one bird in the lake, but there are fifty trappers.

gurmukhi: ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ. ਕਵਣੁ ਗੁਣੁ; ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਮਣੀਆ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
englishTranslation: What is that word, what is that virtue, and what is that magic mantra?
If you are wise, be simple;

gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਫਿਕਾ. ਨ ਗਾਲਾਇ; ਸਭਨਾ ਮੈ ਸਚਾ ਧਣੀ ॥
englishTranslation: Do not utter even a single harsh word; your True Lord and Master abides in all.

gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
englishTranslation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਸਰਿ, ਅਤੁਲ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰਿ; ਪਰੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਰੈ; ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਪਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Streams of Ambrosial Nectar flow; Your Treasures are unweighable and overflowing in abundance. You are the Farthest of the far, Infinite and Incomparably Beautiful.

gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਧਾਰੇ. ਏਕ ਥੇਂ ਕੀਏ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੇ; ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਮਹਿ. ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
englishTranslation: You established all the worlds from within Yourself, and extended them outward. You are All-pervading amongst all, and yet You Yourself remain detached.

gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ. ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨ, ਗੵਾਨੰ ਧੵਾਨੰ; ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚੌ ਜਾਨੀਜੈ, ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਥਾਨੰ ॥
englishTranslation: You are the Treasure of all virtue; who can know the value of Your spiritual wisdom and meditation? O God, Your Place is known as the highest of the high.
O Formless, Formed, Undeceivable, Perfect, Imperishable,

gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ, ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ; ਸਤਿ ਸਤੇ, ਸਤਿ ਭਣੀਐ ॥
englishTranslation: The Lord is said to be True, True, True, True, the Truest of the True.

gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਭਾ. ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਸਚੁ; ਸਚੇ ਪਹਿ ਧਰਿਓ ॥
englishTranslation: True is His Congregation and His Court. The True Lord has established Truth.

gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਜੋਗੁ. ਕਉਨੁ ਗੵਾਨੁ ਧੵਾਨੁ; ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਉਸ੍ਤਤਿ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
englishTranslation: What is the Yoga, what is the spiritual wisdom and meditation, and what is the way, to praise the Lord?

gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਉ ਦਾਤਾਰ; ਪਰੵਿਉ ਜਾਚਕੁ. ਇਕੁ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
englishTranslation: I am a beggar; I seek the Sanctuary of God, the Giver of givers.
Swaiyas From The Mouth Of The Great Fifth Mehl:

gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ; ਜੋਹਨ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਦਾਰਨ ਕਉ ॥
englishTranslation: The Praises of the Creator, the Enticer of the mind, are potent to destroy sins.

gurmukhi: ਰੰਚਕ ਰੇਤ, ਖੇਤ ਤਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਿਤ; ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਧਰੀ ॥
englishTranslation: The little sperm is planted in the body-field of the mother, and the human body, so difficult to obtain, is formed.

gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂਸ, ਬਿਲਾ ਮਹਿ ਗਰਬਤ; ਕਰਤਬ ਕਰਤ ਮਹਾਂ ਮੁਘਨਾਂ ॥
englishTranslation: O mind, you are a mouse, living in the mousehole of the body; you are so proud of yourself, but you act like an absolute fool.

gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਨ ਗੇਹ, ਨ ਨੇਹ ਨ ਨੀਤਾ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮਤ. ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਗਾਰਹੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Neither body, nor house, nor love last forever. You are intoxicated with Maya; how long will you be proud of them?

gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਮਗ ਜੋਹਨ; ਹੀਤੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਦੇ, ਲੇ ਲੇ ਪਾਰੀ ॥
englishTranslation: I have used up my breath of life, sold my self-respect, begged for charity, committed highway robbery, and dedicated my consciousness to the love and pursuit of acquiring wealth.

gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਿਵ ਛੰਦ ਮੁਨੀਸੁਰ; ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ॥
englishTranslation: Brahma, Shiva, the Vedas and the silent sages sing the Glorious Praises of their Lord and Master with love and delight.

gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ, ਬਿਰੰਗ ਕਰਤ ਭ੍ਰਮ; ਮੋਹ ਕੈ ਕੂਪਿ, ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
englishTranslation: The pleasures of Maya shall fade away. In doubt, the mortal falls into the deep dark pit of emotional attachment.

gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਸਮੂਹ ਫਲ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ; ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
englishTranslation: All virtues are obtained, all fruits and rewards, and the desires of the mind; my hopes have been totally fulfilled.

gurmukhi: ਆਵਧ ਕਟਿਓ. ਨ ਜਾਤ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ, ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Weapons cannot cut that person who delights in the love of the Lord's Lotus Feet.

gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਿ. ਲਾਗੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ; ਬਿਚਰਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਖਟੂਆ ॥
englishTranslation: People are engaged in making all sorts of efforts; they contemplate the various aspects of the six Shaastras.
Swaiyas In Praise Of The First Mehl:

gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਨਕਾਦਿ. ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੋਗੇਸੁਰ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ॥
englishTranslation: King Janak and the great Yogic heroes of the Lord's Way, sing the Praises of the All-powerful Primal Being, filled with the sublime essence of the Lord.

gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਪਿਲਾਦਿ, ਆਦਿ ਜੋਗੇਸੁਰ; ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਵਰੋ ॥
englishTranslation: Kapila and the other Yogis sing of Guru Nanak. He is the Avataar, the Incarnation of the Infinite Lord.

gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ. ਬਰਨ ਚਾਰਿ, ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਿਮਰੰਥਿ ਗੁਨਾ ॥
englishTranslation: The four castes and the six Shaastras sing His Glorious Praises; Brahma and the others contemplate His Virtues.

gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਓ; ਬਸਿਓ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਰਿਦੰਤਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: He mastered Raja Yoga, and enjoys sovereignty over both worlds; the Lord, beyond hate and revenge, is enshrined within His Heart.

gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ. ਤੈ ਮਾਣਿਓ; ਛਲਿਓ ਬਲਿ, ਬਾਵਨ ਭਾਇਓ ॥
englishTranslation: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, You were pleased to deceive Baal the king, in the form of a dwarf.

gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ; ਭਗਤੁ ਜੈਦੇਵ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ॥
englishTranslation: His Glorious Praises are sung by the devotees Ravi Daas, Jai Dayv and Trilochan.

gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਯਾਲਿ; ਭਗਤ ਨਾਗਾਦਿ ਭੁਯੰਗਮ ॥
englishTranslation: In the nether worlds, His Praises are sung by the devotees like Shaysh-naag in serpent form.

gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ. ਨਵ ਨਾਥ; ਧੰਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥
englishTranslation: The nine masters of Yoga sing His Praises; blessed is the Guru, who is merged into the True Lord.
Swaiyas In Praise Of The Second Mehl:

gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ, ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ; ਕਾਲੁਖ ਖਨਿ ਉਤਾਰ; ਤਿਮਰ ਅਗੵਾਨ ਜਾਹਿ, ਦਰਸ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
englishTranslation: The Stream of Ambrosial Nectar from His eyes washes away the slime and filth of sins; the sight of His door dispels the darkness of ignorance.

gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਤਉ. ਦ੍ਰਿੜਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ, ਬਿਮਲ ਜਾਸੁ ਬਿਥਾਰੁ; ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸੁਜਨ, ਜੀਆ ਕੋ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: You hold tight to the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord; Your expanse is immaculate. You are the Support of the Siddhas and seekers, and the good and humble beings.

gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਤਾ. ਹਦਰਥਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਾਨੁ, ਸੇਵਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ; ਸਾਧਿ ਅਜਗਰੁ. ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਉਨਮਾਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: You were blessed with glory by the Prophet; You serve the Guru, certified by the Lord, who has subdued the snake of the mind, and who abides in the state of sublime bliss.

gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਰਤ, ਤਮ ਹਰਨ; ਦਹਨ ਅਘ, ਪਾਪ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਸਨ ॥
englishTranslation: Casting Your Glance of Grace, you dispel the darkness, burn away evil, and destroy sin.

gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਕਲ ਲਿਵ ਰਹੈ; ਕਰਨ ਸਿਉ ਇਛਾ ਚਾਰਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Your mind remains lovingly attuned to the Lord forever; You do whatever you desire.

gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ, ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ਪਾਇਓ; ਗਹਰਿ ਗਹੁ ਹਦਰਥਿ ਦੀਓ ॥
englishTranslation: My mind has faith, that the Prophet has given You access to the Profound Lord.

gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ, ਅਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਖੁ; ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
englishTranslation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is our medicine; the Naam is our support; the Naam is the peace of Samaadhi. The Naam is the insignia which embellishes us forever.

gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ. ਸਚੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ, ਅਰੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਚੁ; ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੰਤੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
englishTranslation: The True Name is the sacred shrine, the True Name is the cleansing bath of purification and food. The True Name is eternal love; chant the True Name, and be embellished.

gurmukhi: ਅਮਿਅ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ, ਸੁਭ ਕਰੈ; ਹਰੈ ਅਘ ਪਾਪ, ਸਕਲ ਮਲ ॥
englishTranslation: When You bestow Your Ambrosial Glance of Grace, You eradicate all wickedness, sin and filth.
Swaiyas In Praise Of The Third Mehl:

gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ. ਜਖੵ ਅਰੁ ਕਿੰਨਰ; ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਹਰਾ ॥
englishTranslation: The gods and heavenly heralds, the Siddhas and seekers and Shiva in Samaadhi meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਵਰਿ, ਨਵ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ; ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਸਮੁਧਰਿਆ ॥
englishTranslation: Dwelling upon that Immaculate Naam, the nine Yogic masters, Shiva and Sanak and many others have been emancipated.

gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗਿ, ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ; ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀਸੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
englishTranslation: The three hundred thirty million angels meditate, attached to the Naam; it is enshrined within the minds of the celibates and ascetics.

gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕਿਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ; ਕਿਰਣਿ ਰਵਿ ਸੁਰਤਰ ਸਾਖਹ ॥
englishTranslation: The Glory of the Naam shines forth, like the rays of the sun, and the branches of the Elysian Tree.

gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਦੇਵ ਤੇਤੀਸ, ਅਰੁ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਨਰ; ਨਾਮਿ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
englishTranslation: The thirty-one million gods meditate on the Naam, along with the Siddhas and seekers; the Naam supports solar systems and galaxies.

gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸੂਰਉ ਸੀਲਿ ਬਲਵੰਤੁ; ਸਤ ਭਾਇ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਘਨ, ਗਰੂਅ ਮਤਿ, ਨਿਰਵੈਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
englishTranslation: He is the Warrior Hero of Truth, humility is His Power. His Loving Nature inspires the Congregation with deep and profound understanding; He is absorbed in the Lord, free of hate and vengeance.

gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਵਣੁ, ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸ ਖਾਣੁ, ਅਰੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ; ਸਦਾ ਚਾਯ, ਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਸ੍ਟ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
englishTranslation: The Naam is His cleansing bath; the Naam is the food He eats; the Naam is the taste He enjoys. With deep yearning, He chants the Sweet Bani of the Guru's Word forever.

gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਹਿਣੈ; ਸਿਧਿ. ਸਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਖੁ ਜੋਵੈ ॥
englishTranslation: On His right hand is the sign of the lotus; the Siddhis, the supernatural spiritual powers, await His Command.

gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ. ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ; ਚਰਣ. ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਪਵਲਿ ਰਯ ॥
englishTranslation: Supremely fruitful are the feet which walk upon the path of Guru Amar Daas.

gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਰ ਦੁਖ ਨਹ ਭੁਖ; ਤਿਨਰ ਨਿਧਨ, ਨਹੁ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: They do not suffer pain or hunger, and they cannot be called poor.

gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਪਢਿਅਉ ਇਕੁ, ਮਨਿ ਧਰਿਅਉ ਇਕੁ; ਕਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਓ ॥
englishTranslation: You read about the One Lord, and enshrine Him in Your mind; You realize the One and Only Lord.

gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਮਤਿ ਗਹੀ ਜੈਦੇਵਿ; ਜਿ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਸੰਮਾਣੀ ॥
englishTranslation: The understanding which Jai Dayv grasped, the understanding which permeated Naam Dayv,

gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਪਰਸੀਐ; ਪੁਹਮਿ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਬਿਨਾਸਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Meeting with Guru Amar Daas, the earth is purged of its sin.

gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ; ਸੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿਅਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Guru Nanak gathered up the True Name of the Creator Lord, and implanted it within.

gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ. ਕਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ; ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵਰਿਯਉ ॥
englishTranslation: The Lord Himself wielded His Power and entered the world.

gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ; ਪਿਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਹ ॥
englishTranslation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, the Gursikh is blessed with chanting and deep meditation, truth and contentment.

gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਹਉ; ਪਰੁ ਕਹਿ ਭਿ, ਨ ਸਕਉ ॥
englishTranslation: I consciously pray within my consciousness, but I cannot express it in words.

gurmukhi: ਰਹਿਓ ਸੰਤ ਹਉ ਟੋਲਿ; ਸਾਧ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਡਿਠੇ ॥
englishTranslation: I have been searching for the Saints; I have seen so many Holy and spiritual people.

gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਨਾਹੁ; ਗਿਆਨਿ ਹੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਚੜਿਅਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Wearing the armor of Samaadhi, the Guru has mounted the saddled horse of spiritual wisdom.

gurmukhi: ਘਨਹਰ ਬੂੰਦ. ਬਸੁਅ ਰੋਮਾਵਲਿ; ਕੁਸਮ ਬਸੰਤ. ਗਨੰਤ, ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
englishTranslation: The raindrops of the clouds, the plants of the earth, and the flowers of the spring cannot be counted.
Swaiyas In Praise Of The Fourth Mehl:

gurmukhi: ਛੁਟਤ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਅਮਿਅ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਸਦ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
englishTranslation: The stream of ambrosial nectar flows and the immortal status is obtained; the pool is forever overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar.

gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਗੂੜੑ. ਬਿਮਲ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ; ਆਤਮੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੁ ਭਯਾ ॥
englishTranslation: The True Guru's understanding is deep and profound. The Sat Sangat is His Pure Congregation. His Soul is drenched in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love.

gurmukhi: ਅਨਭਉ ਉਨਮਾਨਿ. ਅਕਲ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ; ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੇ ॥
englishTranslation: With intuitive detachment, He is lovingly attuned to the Fearless, Unmanifest Lord; He met with Guru Amar Daas, the Philosopher's Stone, within his own home.

gurmukhi: ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ, ਪਾਯਉ ਅਪਾਰੁ; ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ॥
englishTranslation: He fills the empty to overflowing; He has enshrined the Infinite within His heart.

gurmukhi: ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਬਸੈ; ਅਮਿਅ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੈ ॥
englishTranslation: You abide in the pool of contentment; Your tongue reveals the Ambrosial Essence.

gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਜਿਤਉ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣਿ; ਮਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਯਉ ॥
englishTranslation: O certified True Guru, You have conquered the world; You meditate single-mindedly on the One Lord.

gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਹ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪੁਬਲੀ. ਨ ਹੁਟਇ ॥
englishTranslation: The flow of loving devotion and primal love does not stop.

gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ; ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ॥
englishTranslation: The Saving Grace of the world, the nine treasures, carries the devotees across the world-ocean.

gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸਧਾ. ਸਹਜੁ ਛਾਵਾਣੁ, ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰਾਇਚਉ; ਸਦਾ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਨਾਹੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
englishTranslation: On the bed of faith, with the blankets of intuitive peace and poise and the canopy of contentment, You are embellished forever with the armor of humility.

gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ. ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ; ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੈ ॥
englishTranslation: The Lord's Name abides in the hearts of those who are pleasing to the Guru.

gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ. ਖੇਮਾ ਤਾਣਿਆ; ਜੁਗ ਜੂਥ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
englishTranslation: The Guru has pitched the tent; under it, all the ages are gathered.

gurmukhi: ਜਨਕੁ ਸੋਇ. ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ; ਉਨਮਨਿ ਰਥੁ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
englishTranslation: He alone is enlightened like Janaka, who links the chariot of his mind to the state of ecstatic realization.

gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ. ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੁ; ਤਿਨੑ ਜਨ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਪੁ. ਕਹੁ ਕਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Tell me, how can sin and suffering cling to that humble being who chants the Naam, given by the Guru, with single-minded love and firm faith?

gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ; ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
englishTranslation: Dharmic faith and the karma of good deeds are obtained from the Perfect True Guru.

gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਪਰ ॥
englishTranslation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, to the True Name, O my True Guru.

gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਤਖਤੁ; ਦੀਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ॥
englishTranslation: Guru Raam Daas was blessed with the Throne of Raja Yoga.

gurmukhi: ਕਚਹੁ. ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭਇਅਉ; ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ. ਸ੍ਰਵਣਹਿ ਸੁਣਿਓ ॥
englishTranslation: Glass is transformed into gold, listening to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

gurmukhi: ਜਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਲਿ; ਧਨਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਗਾਰਵੁ ਦਿਜਇ ॥
englishTranslation: One who has the Guru on his side - how could he be proud of his wealth?

gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਘੋਰੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ; ਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਮਝ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
englishTranslation: Without the Guru, there is utter darkness; without the Guru, understanding does not come.

gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੁ; ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
englishTranslation: Dwell upon the Guru, the Guru, the Guru, O my mind.

gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖੁ ਦੇਖਿ; ਗਰੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਯਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Gazing upon the Face of the Guru, I find peace.
The All-powerful Guru placed His hand upon my head.

gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਰਾਖਹੁ; ਦਾਸ ਭਾਟ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ॥
englishTranslation: Now, please preserve the honor of Your humble slave.

gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ; ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, and know Him as true.

gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ. ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ; ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
englishTranslation: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru; through the Guru, the Lord is obtained.

gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ; ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਮੰਨ ਰੇ ॥
englishTranslation: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, O my mind.
The Great, Supreme Guru showered His Mercy upon all;

gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦੁ ਨਿਤ ਮੰਗਲੁ; ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: The Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan is fruitful and rewarding in this world; it brings lasting bliss and joy.

gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਸਾਗਰੁ; ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ, ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਯਾ ॥
englishTranslation: The Name of the Lord, from the Mouth of the Guru, is the Raft to cross over the unfathomable world-ocean.

gurmukhi: ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ, ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ; ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਯਾ ਜਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ॥
englishTranslation: The Glorious Greatness of the Guru is manifest forever in each and every heart. His humble servants sing His Praises.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਹੁ. ਬਾਤ ਨਿਸ੍ਚਲ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਜਾਨੀ; ਤੇਈ ਜੀਵ. ਕਾਲ ਤੇ ਬਚਾ ॥
englishTranslation: Those who realize the Eternal, Unchanging Word of God, like Dhroo, are immune to death.
Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o.

gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਮ ਧਾਮ, ਸੁਧ ਬੁਧ ਨਿਰੀਕਾਰ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ; ਸਰਬਰ ਕਉ ਕਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
englishTranslation: You are blessed with the Lord's Name, the supreme mansion, and clear understanding. You are the Formless, Infinite Lord; who can compare to You?

gurmukhi: ਪੀਤ ਬਸਨ ਕੁੰਦ ਦਸਨ. ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਸਹਿਤ ਕੰਠ ਮਾਲ; ਮੁਕਟੁ ਸੀਸਿ. ਮੋਰ ਪੰਖ ਚਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
englishTranslation: As Krishna, You wear yellow robes, with teeth like jasmine flowers; You dwell with Your lovers, with Your mala around Your neck, and You joyfully adorn Your head with the crow of peacock feathers.
The True Guru, the True Guru, the True Guru is the Lord of the Universe Himself.

gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ; ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
englishTranslation: The Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the True, Dear Lord.

gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ; ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਦਕਾ ॥
englishTranslation: Your servants are totally fulfilled, throughout the ages; O Waahay Guru, it is all You, forever.
Waaho! Waaho! Great! Great is the Play of God!

gurmukhi: ਕੀਆ ਖੇਲੁ ਬਡ ਮੇਲੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ; ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਚਨਾ ॥
englishTranslation: You have formed and created this play, this great game. O Waahay Guru, this is all You, forever.

gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਨੰਤੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ; ਆਦਿ ਜਿਸੁ. ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
englishTranslation: The Lord is Inaccessible, Infinite, Eternal and Primordial; no one knows His beginning.

gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ, ਗਹਿ ਕਰੀਆ ਧ੍ਰੁਵ; ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰਨ ਕਉ ॥
englishTranslation: I have grasped hold of the All-powerful Guru; He has made my mind steady and stable, and embellished me with clear consciousness.

gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਤ ਹੀ. ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗ; ਸੁਰੰਗ ਰਤੇ, ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਹੈ ॥
englishTranslation: The Saints dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; imbued with pure celestial love, they sing the Lord's Praises.

gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ, ਸੁਧਾ ਪਰਪੂਰਨ; ਸਬਦ ਤਰੰਗ, ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਤ ਦਿਨ ਆਗਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: The Immaculate, Sacred Pool of the Guru is overflowing with the waves of the Shabad, radiantly revealed in the early hours before the dawn.

gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੁਨਿ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਧਰੈ, ਫਿਰਤ ਸਗਲ ਜੁਗ; ਕਬਹੁ ਕ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ, ਆਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਕਉ ॥
englishTranslation: For His Sake, the silent sages meditated and focused their consciousness, wandering all the ages through; rarely, if ever, their souls were enlightened.

gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ. ਧਿਆਨ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ; ਤੇਜ ਪੁੰਜ. ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਗ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੇ ॥
englishTranslation: He focuses His Meditation deep within; the Embodiment of Light, He illuminates the three worlds.

gurmukhi: ਤਾਰੵਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ, ਮਾਯਾ ਮਦ ਮੋਹਿਤ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਅਉ, ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
englishTranslation: The Universe is intoxicated with the wine of Maya, but it has been saved; the All-powerful Guru has blessed it with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.
He is totally pervading and permeating the three realms;

gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ, ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ; ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ. ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦੀਅਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Nanak, the True Guru, worships God single-mindedly; He surrenders His body, mind and wealth to the Lord of the Universe.

gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦੁ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ; ਪੁਬ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜੁ ਗਣੰ ॥
englishTranslation: Naarad, Dhroo, Prahlaad and Sudaamaa are accounted among the Lord's devotees of the past.

gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਕਰਿ, ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਤੁਝੈ ਨਰ; ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਿਟਿਅਉ ਜੁ ਤਿਣੰ ॥
englishTranslation: Those who meditate in remembrance on You within their minds - their sexual desire and anger are taken away.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ; ਨਯਨ ਕੇ ਤਿਮਰ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਖਿਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Those who meditate in remembrance on the True Guru - the darkness of their eyes is removed in an instant.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ. ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਓ; ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਤ. ਨ ਛੋਡਿਓ ਪਾਸੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Living the Word of the Shabad, He attained the supreme status; while performing selfless service, He did not leave the side of Guru Amar Daas.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ. ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਯਉ; ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Whoever serves the True Guru obtains the treasure; night and day, he dwells at the Lord's Feet.

gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਾਨੵਉ; ਕੀਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
englishTranslation: Guru Nanak realized the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. He was lovingly attuned to loving devotional worship of the Lord.

gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਭਰੇ. ਏਕੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛਾਡਿ. ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
englishTranslation: I am overflowing with sins and demerits; I have no merits or virtues at all. I abandoned the Ambrosial Nectar, and I drank poison instead.

gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਮਲਿ ਬਿਵਸਿ ਕੀਅਉ; ਕਾਮੁ ਗਹਿ ਕੇਸ. ਪਛਾੜੵਉ ॥
englishTranslation: He has crushed and overpowered emotional attachment. He seized sexual desire by the hair, and threw it down.

gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ; ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: You are the True Guru, throughout the four ages; You Yourself are the Transcendent Lord.
Swaiyas In Praise Of The Fifth Mehl:
By great good fortune, the mind is uplifted and exalted, and the Word of the Shabad dwells in the heart.
The benign rule of Raja Janak has been established, and the Golden Age of Sat Yuga has begun.

gurmukhi: ਖੇਲੁ ਗੂੜੑਉ ਕੀਅਉ. ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ, ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਮਾਚਰੵਿਓ; ਬਿਮਲ ਬੁਧਿ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਾਣਉ ॥
englishTranslation: The Sovereign Lord King has staged this wondrous play; contentment was gathered together, and pure understanding was infused in the True Guru.

gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ; ਆਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ॥
englishTranslation: O Guru Arjun, You are Eternal, Invaluable, Unborn, Self-existent,

gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ, ਜਾਸੁ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਮੰਦਰਿ ਭਾਗੁ. ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
englishTranslation: His victory is proclaimed all over the world; His Home is blessed with good fortune; He remains united with the Lord.

gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰੰਮ ਧੀਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਭੀਰੁ; ਪਰ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਣੁ ॥
englishTranslation: The Support of the Dharma, immersed in the deep and profound Teachings of the Guru, the Remover of the pains of others.

gurmukhi: ਭੈ. ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮਾਣਿਅਉ; ਲਾਖ ਮਹਿ. ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਯਉ ॥
englishTranslation: In the Fear of God, You enjoy the Fearless Lord; among the thousands of beings, You see the Unseen Lord.

gurmukhi: ਅਮਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ, ਬਦਨਿ ਬਰ ਦਾਤਿ; ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਸੂਰ; ਸਬਦਿ. ਹਉਮੈ ਨਿਵਾਰੵਉ ॥
englishTranslation: Nectar drips from Your tongue, and Your mouth gives Blessings, O Incomprehensible and Infinite Spiritual Hero. O Guru, the Word of Your Shabad eradicates egotism.

gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਸੇਤੁ; ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ਕਾ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ॥
englishTranslation: The Lord's Name is the Boat, the Bridge to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥
englishTranslation: The Naam is the Saving Grace of the world; by the Pleasure of the True Guru, it is obtained.

gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ; ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਾਯਉ ॥
englishTranslation: The Embodiment of Light, the Lord Himself is called Guru Nanak.

gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਉਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: He is the Embodiment of Truth; He has enshrined the True Name, Sat Naam, Truth and contentment within His heart.

gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਜਨ ਜਾਚਹੁ, ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਪਰ ਜਾਨੀਅਤੁ; ਬਾਸੁਰ ਰਯਨਿ ਬਾਸੁ, ਜਾ ਕੋ ਹਿਤੁ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ॥
englishTranslation: I beg from that humble being who is known all over the world, who lives in, and loves the Name, night and day.

gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵਤ, ਦੇਵ ਸਬੈ ਮੁਨਿ; ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਮਹਾ ਸਿਵ ਜੋਗ ਕਰੀ ॥
englishTranslation: All the gods, silent sages, Indra, Shiva and Yogis have not found the Lord's limits

gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਯਾਹਿ ਮਹਾ ਤਮ ਮੈ; ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਉਜਾਗਰੁ, ਆਨਿ ਕੀਅਉ ॥
englishTranslation: In the great darkness of this world, the Lord revealed Himself, incarnated as Guru Arjun.

gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਉ. ਨਹੀ ਭਾਗ ਲਿਲਾਰ ਉਦੈ; ਤਬ ਲਉ. ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਫਿਰਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਯਉ ॥
englishTranslation: As long as the destiny written upon my forehead was not activated, I wandered around lost, running in all directions.

gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰ ਭਏ ਰੂਪ; ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ, ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਉਧਾਰਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: In the ocean of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name has been revealed in the Form of Guru Arjun, to save the world.

gurmukhi: ਅਜੈ ਗੰਗ ਜਲੁ ਅਟਲੁ; ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਭ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
englishTranslation: The stream of the Lord's Name flows like the Ganges, invincible and unstoppable. The Sikhs of the Sangat all bathe in it.

gurmukhi: ਦੇਵ ਪੁਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਗਯਉ; ਆਪਿ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਭਾਯਉ ॥
englishTranslation: When it was the Will of the Transcendent Lord Himself, Guru Raam Daas went to the City of God.

gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
englishTranslation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਹੇ ਰਚਿਓ; ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Why are you engrossed in sin and corruption? You are not detached, even for a moment!

gurmukhi: ਤਰਨਾਪੋ. ਇਉ ਹੀ ਗਇਓ; ਲੀਓ ਜਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਤਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Your youth has passed away like this, and old age has overtaken your body.

gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਓ. ਸੂਝੈ ਨਹੀ; ਕਾਲੁ ਪਹੂਚਿਓ ਆਨਿ ॥
englishTranslation: You have become old, and you do not understand that death is overtaking you.

gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਦਾਰਾ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਸਗਲ; ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Your wealth, spouse, and all the possessions which you claim as your own

gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ. ਉਧਾਰਨ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ; ਹਰਿ. ਅਨਾਥ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ॥
englishTranslation: He is the Saving Grace of sinners, the Destroyer of fear, the Master of the masterless.

gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਹ ਤੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਓ; ਤਾਂ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ. ਨ ਕੀਨ ॥
englishTranslation: He has given you your body and wealth, but you are not in love with Him.

gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਓ; ਅਰੁ ਜਿਹ ਨੀਕੇ ਧਾਮ ॥
englishTranslation: He has given you your body, wealth, property, peace and beautiful mansions.

gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ; ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: The Lord is the Giver of all peace and comfort. There is no other at all.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ. ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਤਿਹ ਭਜੁ ਰੇ ਤੈ ਮੀਤ ॥
englishTranslation: Remembering Him in meditation, salvation is attained; vibrate and meditate on Him, O my friend.

gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚ ਤਤ ਕੋ ਤਨੁ ਰਚਿਓ; ਜਾਨਹੁ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥
englishTranslation: Your body is made up of the five elements; you are clever and wise - know this well.

gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਬਸੈ; ਸੰਤਨ; ਕਹਿਓ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥
englishTranslation: The Dear Lord abides in each and every heart; the Saints proclaim this as true.

gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਿਹ ਪਰਸੈ ਨਹੀ; ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: One who is not touched by pleasure or pain, greed, emotional attachment and egotistical pride

gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਿਹਿ; ਕੰਚਨ ਲੋਹ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
englishTranslation: One who is beyond praise and slander, who looks upon gold and iron alike

gurmukhi: ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਹੀ; ਬੈਰੀ ਮੀਤ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
englishTranslation: One who is not affected by pleasure or pain, who looks upon friend and enemy alike

gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਦੇਤ ਨਹਿ; ਨਹਿ ਭੈ ਮਾਨਤ ਆਨ ॥
englishTranslation: One who does not frighten anyone, and who is not afraid of anyone else

gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਜੀ; ਲੀਓ ਭੇਖ ਬੈਰਾਗ ॥
englishTranslation: One who has forsaken all sin and corruption, who wears the robes of neutral detachment

gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਜੀ; ਸਭ ਤੇ ਭਇਓ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
englishTranslation: One who renounces Maya and possessiveness and is detached from everything

gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੀ; ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਿ ॥
englishTranslation: That mortal, who forsakes egotism, and realizes the Creator Lord

gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਨਾਸਨ. ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਨ; ਕਲਿ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
englishTranslation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Name of the Lord is the Destroyer of fear, the Eradicator of evil-mindedness.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ; ਕਰਨ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Vibrate with your tongue the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe; with your ears, hear the Lord's Name.

gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਜੈ; ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
englishTranslation: That mortal who renounces possessiveness, greed, emotional attachment and egotism

gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਅਰੁ ਪੇਖਨਾ; ਐਸੇ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Like a dream and a show, so is this world, you must know.

gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨੇ; ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਡੋਲਤ ਨੀਤ ॥
englishTranslation: Night and day, for the sake of Maya, the mortal wanders constantly.

gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ; ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨੀਤ ॥
englishTranslation: As the bubbles in the water well up and disappear again,

gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਚੇਤਈ; ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
englishTranslation: The mortal does not remember the Lord, even for a moment; he is blinded by the wine of Maya.

gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਚਾਹੈ ਸਦਾ; ਸਰਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਲੇਹ ॥
englishTranslation: If you yearn for eternal peace, then seek the Sanctuary of the Lord.

gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਧਾਵਹੀ; ਮੂਰਖ ਲੋਗ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
englishTranslation: For the sake of Maya, the fools and ignorant people run all around.

gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ. ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਭਜੈ; ਰੂਪ ਰਾਮ ਤਿਹ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: That mortal who meditates and vibrates upon the Lord night and day - know him to be the embodiment of the Lord.

gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਫਧਿ ਰਹਿਓ; ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
englishTranslation: The mortal is entangled in Maya; he has forgotten the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਰਾਮੁ. ਨ ਚੇਤਈ; ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
englishTranslation: The mortal does not think of the Lord; he is blinded by the wine of Maya.

gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਭਏ; ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: In good times, there are many companions around, but in bad times, there is no one at all.

gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮਤ ਫਿਰਿਓ; ਮਿਟਿਓ ਨ. ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Mortals wander lost and confused through countless lifetimes; their fear of death is never removed.

gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ; ਮਿਟਿਓ ਨ. ਮਨ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: I have tried so many things, but the pride of my mind has not been dispelled.

gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਜੁਆਨੀ ਅਰੁ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਫੁਨਿ; ਤੀਨਿ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਜਾਨਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Childhood, youth and old age - know these as the three stages of life.

gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੋ ਹੁਤੋ. ਸੁ ਨਾ ਕੀਓ; ਪਰਿਓ ਲੋਭ ਕੈ ਫੰਧ ॥
englishTranslation: You have not done what you should have done; you are entangled in the web of greed.

gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਰਮਿ ਰਹਿਓ; ਨਿਕਸਤ ਨਾਹਿਨ. ਮੀਤ ॥
englishTranslation: The mind is absorbed in Maya - it cannot escape it, my friend.

gurmukhi: ਨਰ ਚਾਹਤ ਕਛੁ ਅਉਰ; ਅਉਰੈ ਕੀ ਅਉਰੈ ਭਈ ॥
englishTranslation: The man wishes for something, but something different happens.

gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਬਹੁਤ ਸੁਖ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ; ਦੁਖ ਕੋ ਕੀਓ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: People make all sorts of efforts to find peace and pleasure, but no one tries to earn pain.

gurmukhi: ਜਗਤੁ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ਫਿਰਤੁ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
englishTranslation: The world wanders around begging, but the Lord is the Giver of all.

gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੈ ਮਾਨੁ. ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ; ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Why do you take such false pride in yourself? You must know that the world is just a dream.

gurmukhi: ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ਕੋ; ਬਿਨਸੈ ਛਿਨ ਮੈ ਮੀਤ ॥
englishTranslation: You are so proud of your body; it shall perish in an instant, my friend.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ; ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: That person, who meditates in remembrance on the Lord in his heart, is liberated - know this well.

gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ; ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਮਨਿ ॥
englishTranslation: That person, who does not feel devotion to God in his mind

gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਜਿਉ ਸਦਾ; ਸੁਆਨ ਤਜਤ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਤ ॥
englishTranslation: A dog never abandons the home of his master.

gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਅਰੁ ਦਾਨ ਕਰਿ; ਮਨ ਮੈ ਧਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Those who make pilgrimages to sacred shrines, observe ritualistic fasts and make donations to charity while still taking pride in their minds

gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੁ ਕੰਪਿਓ, ਪਗ ਡਗਮਗੇ; ਨੈਨ ਜੋਤਿ. ਤੇ ਹੀਨ ॥
englishTranslation: The head shakes, the feet stagger, and the eyes become dull and weak.

gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਓ. ਜਗਤੁ ਮੈ; ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
englishTranslation: I had looked upon the world as my own, but no one belongs to anyone else.

gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਰਚਨਾ ਸਭ ਝੂਠ ਹੈ; ਜਾਨਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
englishTranslation: The world and its affairs are totally false; know this well, my friend.

gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਗਇਓ; ਰਾਵਨੁ ਗਇਓ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
englishTranslation: Raam Chand passed away, as did Raawan, even though he had lots of relatives.

gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ. ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੀਐ; ਜੋ ਅਨਹੋਨੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: People become anxious, when something unexpected happens.

gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਪਜਿਓ. ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਹੈ; ਪਰੋ ਆਜੁ ਕੈ ਕਾਲਿ ॥
englishTranslation: Whatever has been created shall be destroyed; everyone shall perish, today or tomorrow.

gurmukhi: ਬਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੁਟੇ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਤ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
englishTranslation: My strength has been restored, and my bonds have been broken; now, I can do everything.

gurmukhi: ਸੰਗ ਸਖਾ ਸਭਿ ਤਜਿ ਗਏ; ਕੋਊ. ਨ ਨਿਬਹਿਓ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
englishTranslation: My associates and companions have all deserted me; no one remains with me.

gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਓ. ਸਾਧੂ ਰਹਿਓ; ਰਹਿਓ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ॥
englishTranslation: The Naam remains; the Holy Saints remain; the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, remains.

gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਮੈ ਗਹਿਓ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਮ. ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
englishTranslation: I have enshrined the Lord's Name within my heart; there is nothing equal to it.
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
